latest snapshot. Returns empty sections (not an error) before the first sync.

Daily flow-adjusted portfolio value, indexed to 100 at the start of the window,
against the first configured benchmark symbol. Deposits and withdrawals are excluded
from the index so day-over-day change is investment return only, never a false gain
or loss from money moving in or out. Empty (with `gap` set) before the first sync or
with fewer than two snapshots in the window.

Every holding's contribution to the portfolio's return over the window, in base
currency: its own trading (buying or selling more of it) netted out, so a holding is
ranked by what the market actually did to it, not by how much was bought or sold.
Empty (with `gap` set) before the first sync, or with no position snapshot in the
window.

Sharpe ratio of the portfolio and of the first benchmark over the window: the
time-weighted daily returns of /portfolio/history (weekdays) in the base currency, in
excess of the forward-filled CZK risk-free rate (CZEONIA from the ČNB, /100/252 per
trading day), annualised by sqrt(252); with the annualised volatility, mean excess
return, average risk-free rate, the window and the number of observations. `sharpe` is
null with a `reason` under 60 observations or without a stored risk-free rate.

Today's risk from the current weights: the forecast annualised volatility (the higher
of an EWMA and a Ledoit-Wolf covariance model on three years of weekly base-currency
returns, cash at zero volatility), each position's Euler share of it, the shares summed by
tier, sector, country and currency, the diversification ratio, the effective number of
independent bets, the tier-criterion volatility checks and the coverage: which weight rests
on a proxy-backfilled history and which is left out. `volatility_forecast` is null with a
`reason` when no position has enough history.

The bad-month numbers for today's weights, on weekly returns: Value at Risk and Expected
Shortfall at 95 and 99 % over one week and one month (historical, filtered-historical and
Cornish-Fisher), each position's part of the Expected Shortfall, the simulated chance of the
`max_drawdown` fall within 1, 2 and 3 years with drawdown and terminal-value quantiles, and
the downside statistics of the weekly record. `available` is false, with a `reason`, when
there is no book or too little history.

rewrite what was shown.

size, value, profitability, investment and momentum styles, the US dollar and the euro
against the base currency, and the US 10-year yield. Each holding is moved by its measured
loadings; an owner beta replaces only the market loading. Holdings without loadings use the
owner's fallback beta, else stay flat and are listed. Nothing is saved.

get.description:
Does the risk model's forecast match what happened? A weekly back-test on today's
holdings: Kupiec and Christoffersen tests of the 95 % and 99 % value-at-risk, and the ratio
of realised to forecast volatility. `confidence` is `reduced` and `review_item` is set when
a test fails; `untested` when too little history exists.

Factor exposures of the portfolio, the first benchmark and each holding, from two years
of weekly base-currency returns regressed on the Ken French factors of the chosen region
(market, size, value, profitability, investment, momentum) and the US dollar and euro
against the base currency. Each loading has a Newey-West t-statistic. `tilts` compare the
portfolio with the benchmark; a style tilt beyond 0.3 is `flagged` as a concentration note,
not a breach. `reason` is set when no factor data is stored yet.

Rank candidate ideas (comma-separated price symbols with stored daily prices) by how much
each would reduce the portfolio's dominant style tilt if held at `weight`, paid for from
cash. A tie-breaker between comparable ideas (strategy principle 7c), not a recommendation;
an idea without stored prices is listed with the reason.

Risk-aware starting size for a stock: the smaller of the tier's starting cap (principle
8b) and the largest weight that raises no new ex-ante limit breach, with the quarter-Kelly
upper bound and its inputs where the stock has a thesis. A ceiling, never a target.

The risk page of a thesis review: the holding's share of the portfolio's risk against its
weight, the holdings it moves with (weekly correlation 0.6 or more) and its worst past
episodes. Expected Shortfall is not modelled yet and the response says so.

Where a deposit (base currency) should go under principle 8c, in whole shares, with every
rule, cap, band and ex-ante limit respected and the risk impact of each line. Read-only.

Stocks above the single-position cap (principle 4f): how long deposits alone take to
dilute each under the cap, and the sale that trims it to 8 %.

Named past episodes (2008, 2011, the end of the CZK floor, 2020, 2022) replayed on
today's weights in the base currency: the portfolio loss, the three worst contributors and
whether the drawdown limit would be reached. A position without prices in the episode is
moved by its beta on the best-fitting proxy and labelled `proxied`; one with neither stays
flat and is listed as `unavailable`. Episodes before the stored price history return
`no_data`.

research_max_per_run.description: Most research runs one autopilot run may queue.

draft_theses.description: Queue a deep-thesis research run for a held, non-core holding that has no thesis, and tell you once when the draft is ready. Nothing is saved until you accept.

draft_max_per_run.title: Draft Max Per Run
draft_max_per_run.description: Most thesis drafts one autopilot run may queue.

draft_min_days.title: Draft Min Days
draft_min_days.description: No new draft for a holding this soon after a report.

review_extend_days.title: Review Extend Days

audit_per_run.title: Audit Per Run
audit_per_run.description: Decisions with no review that the calibration job has the stronger model re-judge independently each run (agreement counts as a correct decision).

The autopilot: the app settles its own review queues, logs every decision with its
evidence, and asks the owner only for what it cannot settle with confidence.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Quote currency of the series (ISO code).

foreign_share.title: Foreign Share
foreign_share.description: Share in currencies other than the base currency.

BenchmarkProxy.title: BenchmarkProxy
BenchmarkProxy.description: Which fund's holdings stand in for a benchmark index's constituents.

benchmark_return.title: Benchmark Return
benchmark_return.description: Benchmark return over the same dates.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: total, price or unknown: whether dividends are included.

like_for_like.title: Like For Like
like_for_like.description: The benchmark is quoted in the base currency and includes dividends.

active_total.title: Active Total
active_total.description: Sum of the holdings' active contributions.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: The Prices benchmark symbol it stands for.

status.title: Status
status.description: The current verdict's status; unknown when there is none yet.

overall.title: Overall
overall.description: breach if any KPI breaches, else unknown if any is unknown, else pass.

open_review_items.title: Open Review Items
open_review_items.description: Held or quarantined facts for this holding.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0-100: 100 x mean s_k over KPIs with a verdict, rounded half up; s_k = 1 pass, 0.5 unknown or stale, 0 breach. Null when no KPI has been judged. See score_method.

score_history.title: Score History
score_history.description: The score as of the end of each UTC day a verdict for one of this holding's KPIs was recorded (latest 12 such days, oldest first).

state.title: State
state.description: unjudged: no score. Else by breaching KPIs (current verdict breach): intact none, watch one, at_risk two or more.

cache_write_multiplier.title: Cache Write Multiplier
cache_write_multiplier.description: Cache-write tokens cost this times the input price.

cache_read_multiplier.title: Cache Read Multiplier
cache_read_multiplier.description: Cache-read tokens cost this times the input price.

batch_multiplier.title: Batch Multiplier
batch_multiplier.description: Batch API requests cost this times the token price (searches excluded).

monthly_cap_usd.title: Monthly Cap Usd
monthly_cap_usd.description: Most AI spend per calendar month (Europe/Prague), in USD. Null: no cap.

warn_at_fraction.title: Warn At Fraction
warn_at_fraction.description: One alert per month when spend passes this fraction of the monthly cap.

at_cap.title: At Cap
at_cap.description: At the monthly cap: only alert; fail non-critical jobs before their next AI request; or run their requests on `downgrade_model`.

downgrade_model.title: Downgrade Model
downgrade_model.description: The model non-critical requests use at the cap (`downgrade_noncritical`).

critical_job_types.title: Critical Job Types
critical_job_types.description: Job types that run normally at the monthly cap.

per_job_cap_usd.title: Per Job Cap Usd
per_job_cap_usd.description: Most AI spend of one run of a job type, in USD. A run over it fails.

default_job_cap_usd.title: Default Job Cap Usd
default_job_cap_usd.description: Most AI spend of one run of a job type not in `per_job_cap_usd`. Null: no cap.

per_job_monthly_cap_usd.title: Per Job Monthly Cap Usd
per_job_monthly_cap_usd.description: Most AI spend of one job type per calendar month (Europe/Prague), in USD, so one stage cannot use the whole monthly budget. A run over it fails before its next request, whatever its criticality.

holiday_countries.title: Holiday Countries
holiday_countries.description: Countries whose public holidays are loaded from Nager.Date.

exchange_closures.title: Exchange Closures
exchange_closures.description: Days an exchange is closed (public holidays are not exchange calendars; confirm the suggestions on the calendar page). Used without a deploy.

CalendarSettings.title: CalendarSettings
CalendarSettings.description: The expected-gap calendar: days when a source has nothing to publish or collect.

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: Left empty on purpose: the owner supplies the right answer.

observed.title: Observed
observed.description: Figures the app computed from filings and disclosures, kept apart from your items.

observed_note.title: Observed Note
observed_note.default: Observed figures are computed by the app from filed statements and confirmed disclosures. They are evidence to cite, not a verdict; an empty one says what is missing.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: A disabled rule is kept in the config (and still validated) but never evaluated: no breach, no review compliance row, not offered to the AI.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: A disabled rule is kept in the config (and still validated) but never evaluated: no breach, no review compliance row, not offered to the AI.

CategoryWeightRule.title: CategoryWeightRule
CategoryWeightRule.description: Limit on a category's weight; with no bucket it applies to every bucket of the dimension.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why there is no value, or a note.

derived.title: Derived
derived.description: How the value was computed, if not filed.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: money, per_share, shares or fraction (after a transform).

not_covered.title: Not Covered
default: Ownership and insiders are compared by period (the two latest 13F quarters, the last 90 days of insider trades against the 90 before), not by what the app knew on a date.
Patents: only new families are listed; a change inside a family is not tracked.
Trade exposures: trade series are not compared between dates here.

method.title: Method
method.default: Each area is compared as the app knew it at the end of the earlier day and as it knows it now. Items are sorted by a 0-100 relevance score: 60 points for the share of the portfolio in the company or fund they concern (full at 10%) and 40 for how much that kind of change in that area usually matters (fixed factors, not learned). A first-time record is 'new'; only a changed value for the same period is 'revised'. Prices compare the two portfolio snapshots and show moves of 3% or more.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of the portfolio concerned; null if none.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.description: 0-100 score; see the method for its parts.

isin.title: Isin
isin.description: The fund's ISIN for a fund channel.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of total portfolio value.

CharacteristicsAuditRow.title: CharacteristicsAuditRow
CharacteristicsAuditRow.description: One parser-drift audit observation of issuer fund P/E and P/B.

visuals.title: Visuals
visuals.description: Charts drawn by the app from stored records.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: 'low_evidence': nothing in the draft ended up as a checked, sourced claim — the panel should show the raw sources found instead of prose that reads confident despite having no backing, rather than a fluent answer marked unsupported sentence by sentence after the fact.

no_source.title: No Source
no_source.description: Shown as 'no source': nothing checkable cites it.

unsupported.title: Unsupported
unsupported.description: Why a figure in it is not in its sources, when that is so.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

escalation_model.title: Escalation Model
escalation_model.description: Cascade (cost lever C6): when set, a question the model above could not answer (no parseable answer, a refusal, the step cap, or an answer that says it has too little evidence or cites nothing) is asked again on this stronger model. Leave empty until the chat question set shows the cheaper model above holds quality; the first attempt is still paid for.

escalation_effort.title: Escalation Effort
escalation_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

rules_first.title: Rules First
rules_first.description: Answer a short, closed question about the portfolio's value or cash from the database with a template (no model call); everything else goes to the assistant.

max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Model calls plus tool rounds per answer.

search_via_api.title: Search Via Api
search_via_api.description: Cost lever H2: search the news through a plain search API (needs BRAVE_API_KEY) instead of the model provider's built-in search, and keep identical searches for a few days. The model gets titles and snippets only, from the outlet tiers allowed above. Falls back to the provider's search when no key is set.

search_cache_days.title: Search Cache Days
search_cache_days.description: Days an identical API search is answered from memory.

cache_retention.title: Cache Retention
cache_retention.description: Cost lever H1: ask OpenAI to keep the chat prompt prefix cached for 24 hours instead of minutes, so the second question of the day reads the system prompt and tool list at the cached rate. Unverified for every model; leave off until a test call is accepted and the bill shows no cache-write charge that outweighs it.

history_messages.title: History Messages
history_messages.description: Earlier messages of the conversation sent along.

source_tiers.title: Source Tiers
source_tiers.description: Outlet tiers web search may use and an answer may cite (News sources config).

freshness_days.title: Freshness Days
freshness_days.description: Days after which the data_freshness tool calls a dataset stale: portfolio_snapshot, news, macro, fundamentals, price_bars, fx, insider_filings, transactions. A dataset left out uses its built-in limit.

ChatSettings.title: ChatSettings
ChatSettings.description: The chat panel's assistant: DB tools, web search on tiered outlets, cited answers.

ClaimCheckSummary.title: ClaimCheckSummary
ClaimCheckSummary.description: What the claim verifier did to a report, stored with it.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The report as a whole, from its claims and checks.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: strip: remove an unsupported sentence; mark: keep it, marked unsupported.

numeric_check.title: Numeric Check
numeric_check.description: Before the model call, code checks that every number in a sentence appears in a snippet it cites; a sentence that fails is unsupported without a call.

date_check.title: Date Check
date_check.description: Code checks that every full date in a sentence (2026-11-12, 12 November 2026, November 12, 2026) appears in a snippet it cites; a sentence that fails is unsupported without a model call.

quote_check.title: Quote Check
quote_check.description: A sentence that is a verbatim run of a cited snippet (and passed the number and date checks) is supported without a model call.

applies_to.title: Applies To
applies_to.description: Reports whose sentences are checked. Alerts are composed in code from the source's own headline, so they have no model-written sentences to check.

ClaimVerifierSettings.title: ClaimVerifierSettings
ClaimVerifierSettings.description:
The claim verifier (layer 4): every model-written sentence is checked against the
snippets it cites before a report is stored or sent.

trigger_before_close.title: Trigger Before Close
trigger_before_close.description: A finding opened on the ticker during the holding period; None when the thesis did not lose money.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why there is no return, when there is none.

series.title: Series
series.description: czeonia: the CZK overnight reference rate, daily (yearly.txt/daily.txt; the portfolio's risk-free rate). repo_2w: the 2-week repo rate's change history.

CnbSeries.title: CnbSeries
CnbSeries.description: A Czech National Bank rate from its keyless text files.

snoozed.title: Snoozed
snoozed.description: Issues set aside until a date; they return on it.

affected_weight.title: Affected Weight
affected_weight.description: Share of the portfolio touched by at least one issue (holdings counted once).

evidence_tier.title: Evidence Tier
evidence_tier.description: Ignored. The server derives the tier from the linked document's source class (or the writing source); rejecting or disputing an edge uses the decision endpoint.

CompanyResearchObservation.title: CompanyResearchObservation
CompanyResearchObservation.description: One `company_research_observation` row; `raw` is the decoded jsonb payload.

note.title: Note
note.default: Scenarios are assumptions you set, not forecasts the app makes. The range spans your scenarios; no single value is offered, and a margin of safety is shown only against the scenario you select.

person.title: Person
person.description: Name and position as the proxy statement gives them.

components.title: Components
components.description: Only the components the provider sent; an absent one is not zero.

id.title: Id
id.description: The strategy rule id, or hard_limit:/band: keys.

hhi.title: Hhi
hhi.description: Sum of squared weights (weights renormalised to 1).

effective_n.title: Effective N
effective_n.description: 1 / HHI: as concentrated as this many equal names.

exempt.title: Exempt
exempt.description: Over the cap but exempt (core ETFs).

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Active version per config domain (strategy, theses, jobs, ...).

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Number of changed paths against the previous version; null for the first.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Number of changed paths against the previous version; null for the first.

note.title: Note
note.default: Public analyst consensus as published, one row per vintage. Provider earnings-calendar estimates are a different kind and are not shown here.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: One series per provider: providers are never mixed.

revision_since_previous.title: Revision Since Previous
revision_since_previous.description: Latest value minus the previous vintage's; null unless both are known.

benchmark_equivalent.title: Benchmark Equivalent
benchmark_equivalent.description: What this holding's opening value would have gained in the benchmark.

active.title: Active
active.description: Total contribution minus the benchmark equivalent.

active_reason.title: Active Reason
active_reason.description: Why there is no active figure for this holding.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Date of the latest position snapshot included.

holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.description: Every holding with at least two snapshots in the window, ranked by contribution: largest positive first, largest negative last.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Why there is no contribution report, when there is none.

stakes.title: Stakes
stakes.description: Latest filing of each amendment chain (not restated by a later filing).

superseded.title: Superseded
superseded.description: Earlier filings of those chains, newest first, with their own changes.

CorporateActionDecision.title: CorporateActionDecision
CorporateActionDecision.description:
The owner's explicit decision on one recorded action: confirm it, reject it, or retract
it back to review (`suggested`). Only this path changes a decided action.

average.title: Average
average.description: Mean of the pairs that have enough observations.

tier1_confirms_alone.title: Tier1 Confirms Alone
tier1_confirms_alone.description: A tier-1 source (the company, a regulator, a statistics office) confirms a story on its own. Off: it counts as one independent source like a tier-2 outlet.

independent_sources_to_confirm.title: Independent Sources To Confirm
independent_sources_to_confirm.description: Independent tier-2 outlets (different stories, not copies of one wire story) needed to confirm a story.

CorroborationRules.title: CorroborationRules
CorroborationRules.description: When a news story counts as confirmed (layer 2).

period_start.title: Period Start
period_start.description: Start of the budget month (midnight on the 1st, Europe/Prague), inclusive.

period_end.title: Period End
period_end.description: End of the budget month (midnight on the 1st of the next), exclusive.

total_usd.title: Total Usd
total_usd.description: Sum of `job_step.cost_usd` of steps started in month.

fraction.title: Fraction
fraction.description: total / cap; null without a cap.

expected_periods.title: Expected Periods
expected_periods.description: Sum of known expected periods; null if no entry states one.

available_periods.title: Available Periods
available_periods.description: Sum of available periods over the entries that state an expected count, so it is comparable with expected_periods; null if there is none.

entries_with_expected.title: Entries With Expected
entries_with_expected.description: Entries that state an expected-period count (the ratio's denominator).

coverage_ratio.title: Coverage Ratio
coverage_ratio.description: available_periods / expected_periods over the entries that state both; null unless the expected total is positive. Entries without an expected count are in neither term.

note.title: Note
note.default: Counts are of stored coverage-ledger entries, not of the global universe. An entity with no ledger entry is unknown, not covered or uncovered.

CreditContext.title: CreditContext
CreditContext.description: The market-wide US high-yield spread. It is not a sector figure.

series_id.title: Series Id
series_id.description: `macro_observation.series_id`: a FRED/ECB series key from the jobs config or a BIS series key (e.g. debt_service).

CreditStressRule.title: CreditStressRule
CreditStressRule.description:
A threshold on one stored macro series. Fires once, when a genuinely new observation
(a later period than any known before it) is beyond the threshold and the previous
period was not; a revision of an old period never fires.

task.title: Task
task.description: What the section should answer, in plain words. No links or markup.

CustomSection.title: CustomSection
CustomSection.description:
A section the owner defines: a title and the question it answers. Written by the model
from the same sources, cited like any other. It has no code-written figures, so it cannot
stand in for a trusted calculation.

coverage_ratio.title: Coverage Ratio
coverage_ratio.description: available_periods / expected_periods; null unless both are known and the expected count is positive.

age_days.title: Age Days
age_days.description: Days from latest_period to today; null without a period.

size.title: Size
size.description: Stated consideration (a lower bound) or financing.

current_state.title: Current State
current_state.description: State of the latest confirmed event by the cutoff; null when none is.

value.title: Value
value.description: Whole units of the currency, or a fraction for a share.

effective_at.title: Effective At
effective_at.description: When it took effect in the world.

known_at.title: Known At
known_at.description: When it became known; never earlier than the record.

DecisionBody.title: DecisionBody
DecisionBody.description:
The owner's explicit decision. `confirm` needs evidence (or, for an edge, a cited
passage); `reject` and `dispute` may move an already confirmed row; `reopen` returns a
rejected or disputed row to review (and lifts the shared rejection).

id.description: The id of the first report.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of the portfolio held in the affected ticker today; None when no ticker is named or it is not held.

note.title: Note
note.default: Only confirmed relationships are listed. Suggested and disputed candidates, and legacy edges without a known-at date, are excluded; an anonymous counterparty is never given a name and a missing share stays null.

status.title: Status
status.description: Review state as of the requested date.

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: Hints that the passage is not a current relationship.

entity.description: Who a name may refer to. Only an identifier match is automatic.

awards.title: Awards
awards.description: Procurement notice fields; no revenue share.

inbound_claims.title: Inbound Claims
inbound_claims.description: Claims other reporters made about this holding.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Out-of-band weights and breaches open in the period.

macro.title: Macro
macro.description: Latest macro figures, each with its release and URL.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.description: Public holidays in the period and the next 7 days.

dropped_sentences.title: Dropped Sentences
dropped_sentences.description: Written sentences removed because they cited nothing given.

ownership_changes.title: Ownership Changes
ownership_changes.description: Tracked managers' new and exited positions in holdings, from 13F filings received in the period.

claims.description: The claim verifier's pass over the written sentences.

disclosure_alerts.title: Disclosure Alerts
disclosure_alerts.description: Public-disclosure alerts raised in the period (newest first, at most 30).

disclosure_alerts_more.title: Disclosure Alerts More
disclosure_alerts_more.description: Alerts of the period left out of the list above.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Provenance: read straight from the document, or an owner correction — a different question from confidence or relation.

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: Whether this figure supports, contradicts, or merely mentions the claim it backs — distinct from its own confidence.

DigestFactSource.title: DigestFactSource
DigestFactSource.description: A fact a digest sentence or verdict cites, with the snippet it was read from.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

use_batch.title: Use Batch
use_batch.description: Write the summary through the Batch API (half price).

batch_wait_minutes.title: Batch Wait Minutes
batch_wait_minutes.description: How long to wait for the batch before writing the summary directly.

min_severity_summarised.title: Min Severity Summarised
min_severity_summarised.description: Stories at or above this severity get a written summary; the rest are listed by headline.

min_severity_listed.title: Min Severity Listed
min_severity_listed.description: Stories below this severity are left out of the digest entirely (at most min_severity_summarised).

daily_window_hours.title: Daily Window Hours
daily_window_hours.description: The daily digest covers this many past hours.

weekly_window_days.title: Weekly Window Days
weekly_window_days.description: The weekly digest covers this many past days.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The item's own text, as stored.

news_item_ids.title: News Item Ids
news_item_ids.description: The story's items, lead item first.

value.title: Value
value.description: Threshold, or the allowed categories for `in`.

definition_version.title: Definition Version
definition_version.description: Pin the definition; a mismatch is rejected.

period.title: Period
period.description: Pin the period rule; a mismatch is rejected.

page_age.title: Page Age
page_age.description: The provider's age, if it gave one.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.description: Undated, likely paywalled, or why it was excluded.

DiscoveredUrl.title: DiscoveredUrl
DiscoveredUrl.description: One URL the search returned, kept whether or not a sentence cites it.

evaluated.title: Evaluated
evaluated.description: Records with at least one metric value.

unknown_excluded.title: Unknown Excluded
unknown_excluded.description: Left out because a filtered metric had no value.

no_data.title: No Data
no_data.description: Records with no data to test at all.

supporting.title: Supporting
supporting.description: Verified sources found to support it.

note.title: Note
note.description: What the corroboration search found, in a sentence.

verdicts_frozen.title: Verdicts Frozen
verdicts_frozen.description: The holding's verdicts do not change until this story is resolved.

embedding_model.title: Embedding Model
embedding_model.description: Embeds the passages and the search queries. Changing it re-embeds every passage over the following runs.

embedding_dimensions.title: Embedding Dimensions
embedding_dimensions.description: 768 is the dimension the vector index is built for; others are stored and searched without the index.

filings_per_run.title: Filings Per Run
filings_per_run.description: Archived documents read and split per run.

index_disclosures.title: Index Disclosures
index_disclosures.description: Index the disclosure register's prose: relationship passages and alerts.

disclosure_alert_days.title: Disclosure Alert Days
disclosure_alert_days.description: Disclosure alerts of this many days are indexed.

index_agent_notes.title: Index Agent Notes
index_agent_notes.description: Index your working notes for the agent.

news_days.title: News Days
news_days.description: News older than this is not added to the index (full-text search over the stored news is unaffected).

DocumentIndexSettings.title: DocumentIndexSettings
DocumentIndexSettings.description:
The passage index that `search_documents` reads: filings and results releases, your
reports, theses and notes, and news, split into passages and embedded. Text is indexed
first (keyword search works at once); embedding is capped per run, newest first, so one run
costs a bounded amount. A changed document is re-indexed; an unchanged one is never
embedded twice.

superseded_by_id.title: Superseded By Id
superseded_by_id.description: Shown only when the superseding version was itself known at the cutoff.

is_current.title: Is Current
is_current.description: The version in force at the cutoff.

start_drawdown.title: Start Drawdown
start_drawdown.description: How far below its one-year peak today's book is; the paths start there.

model.title: Model
model.description: Reads report dates off IR calendar pages.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

refresh_within_days.title: Refresh Within Days
refresh_within_days.description: The weekly run refreshes holdings reporting within this many days (and those with no date); the quarterly run refreshes every holding.

use_batch.title: Use Batch
use_batch.description: Read the IR pages in one provider batch (about half the price, results within hours). Only for OpenAI and Google models.

EarningsCalendarSettings.title: EarningsCalendarSettings
EarningsCalendarSettings.description: Next report dates: Finnhub for US issuers, the IR calendar page otherwise.

report_date.title: Report Date
report_date.description: Report date to look for. Default: the instrument's report date if it has passed, else today.

url.title: Url
url.description: Use this document instead of searching (a press release or report).

locate_model.title: Locate Model
locate_model.description: Searches for the release when EDGAR has none (non-US issuers).

locate_effort.title: Locate Effort
locate_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

result_cache_days.title: Result Cache Days
result_cache_days.description: Cost lever: when above 0, an identical request (the same release search, the same document read) within this many days is answered from memory instead of being searched and paid for again. max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Model calls plus document fetches per run.

check_days_after_report.title: Check Days After Report
check_days_after_report.description: Days after the report date on which the check runs until it finds the release (the spec's +1, retry at +2 and +4).

xbrl_for_filings.title: Xbrl For Filings
xbrl_for_filings.description: When the document is a 10-Q or 10-K already on EDGAR, take the standard figures from its XBRL (each still validated against the document text) and call the model only for the rest. Not measured against a golden set yet.

kpi_history_periods.title: Kpi History Periods
kpi_history_periods.description: Past periods (quarters or years) judged for each KPI's history.

EarningsCheckSettings.title: EarningsCheckSettings
EarningsCheckSettings.description: The earnings thesis check: find the release, extract figures, validate, judge KPIs.

EarningsMoves.title: EarningsMoves
EarningsMoves.description:
How the price moved around past results, so a position ahead of a binary event can be
sized down (principle 4e). Each move runs from the close before the report date to the first
close after it, which covers results released before or after the market.

status.title: Status
status.description: matched, candidate, ambiguous, none or anonymous.

es_share.title: Es Share
es_share.description: Share of the book's one-month 95 % Expected Shortfall.

part_of_es.title: Part Of Es
part_of_es.description: That figure as a part of the total (adds to 1).

thesis_link.title: Thesis Link
thesis_link.description: The thesis KPIs/exit conditions touched, or 'none'.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: The event_escalation run that wrote the note.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Model and search cost of that run (sum of its steps); null when no step recorded a cost.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where the owner is with it.

acknowledged_at.title: Acknowledged At
acknowledged_at.description: When the owner first acknowledged (or directly resolved) it; kept when reopened.

resolved_at.title: Resolved At
resolved_at.description: When the owner resolved it; null unless resolved.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Model calls plus web searches per escalation.

source_tiers.title: Source Tiers
source_tiers.description: Outlet tiers web search may use (News sources config).

price_move_news_days.title: Price Move News Days
price_move_news_days.description: A price-move note reads the holding's news from this many days before the move.

EscalationSettings.title: EscalationSettings
EscalationSettings.description: Event escalation: an impact note on a confirmed severity-2+ story or a price move.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The stored text the note's sentences are checked against.

acknowledged.title: Acknowledged
acknowledged.description: Escalations acknowledged and not resolved now.

median_minutes_to_ack.title: Median Minutes To Ack
median_minutes_to_ack.description: Median minutes from an escalation being written to its first acknowledgement, over those acknowledged in the window. Null when none was.

per_day.title: Per Day
per_day.description: Every day of the window, oldest first, today last (zeros included).

days.title: Days
days.description: Length of the window in days, today included.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Time zone the days are counted in.

reached_weight.title: Reached Weight
reached_weight.description: Portfolio weight in the companies reached, once each.

method.title: Method
method.default: A path follows confirmed supply-chain links from the company in the event. The confidence of a path is its weakest link: a link is high when it is a stated fact (owner-entered or a confirmed filing disclosure) with a stated revenue share and a date within three years, medium when it has no stated share, and low when it is older than three years. Severity is high only for a confirmed event on a path of high links that reaches at least 2% of the portfolio. A revenue share is shown only for a single customer link that states one.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The weakest link on the path.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Portfolio weight in the company at the end of the path.

direct_weight.title: Direct Weight
direct_weight.description: Of that weight, the part held directly.

fund_weight.title: Fund Weight
fund_weight.description: Of that weight, the part held in funds.

revenue_share.title: Revenue Share
revenue_share.description: Share of the end supplier's revenue that the lost customer represents, only for a single customer link that states one.

indicators.title: Indicators
indicators.description: Thesis indicators of the end company to watch.

severities.title: Severities
severities.description: Severity per event type; a type left out keeps its default.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Per-holding severity for one event type.

escalate_when_thesis_linked.title: Escalate When Thesis Linked
escalate_when_thesis_linked.description: Event types raised one level (max 3) when the item touches a thesis KPI or exit condition.

insider_cluster_count.title: Insider Cluster Count
insider_cluster_count.description: Insider transactions for one holding within the window that count as cluster buying or selling (raised to severity 2).

recycled_after_days.title: Recycled After Days
recycled_after_days.description: An item whose event happened this long before it was published is a recycled story: shown, never alerted.

thesis_breach_severity.title: Thesis Breach Severity
thesis_breach_severity.description: Severity of an alert for a KPI breach found by an earnings check (0: never alert, the digest still lists it).

price_move_threshold_pct.title: Price Move Threshold Pct
price_move_threshold_pct.description: A daily close-to-close move beyond +-this percentage queues an event escalation for the holding.

macro_surprise_bands.title: Macro Surprise Bands
macro_surprise_bands.description: Per macro series key: a new release that moves more than this against the previous one is a macro surprise (in the series' own unit; 0: any change, e.g. a policy rate set exactly; fed_funds is the daily effective rate, which drifts, so it needs a band). Evaluated only on release days.

announcement_types.title: Announcement Types
announcement_types.description: How RNS and EQS announcement types map to event types.

earnings_check_on.title: Earnings Check On
earnings_check_on.description: Confirmed stories of these types queue an earnings thesis check for the holding, unless one ran within earnings_check_cooldown_days.

earnings_check_cooldown_days.title: Earnings Check Cooldown Days
earnings_check_cooldown_days.description: A story does not queue an earnings check when one was queued or ran for the holding within this many days.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Provenance kind; null on items stored before N5.

independence_key.title: Independence Key
independence_key.description: Items sharing a key are one source (a wire and its republishers).

links.title: Links
links.description: Why the item is tied to each holding.

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: Whether this source supports, contradicts, or merely mentions the claim — distinct from confidence, which is how sure we are the value itself is right.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Provenance, a different question from confidence: read straight from the document, or a correction the owner entered.

evidence_url.title: Evidence Url
evidence_url.description: Signed URL of the archived copy, valid 10 minutes.

context.title: Context
context.description: The archived text around the snippet.

volatility_forecast.title: Volatility Forecast
volatility_forecast.description: The higher of the two, tested against the volatility limit.

volatility_forecast_scaled.title: Volatility Forecast Scaled
volatility_forecast_scaled.description: The forecast divided by the covered share of the invested weight: what it would be if the positions left out for lack of history carried the average risk of the rest. Equal to the forecast when nothing is left out. Shown, not tested.

weight_basis.title: Weight Basis
weight_basis.description: The strategy's weight basis, which the page uses to show sizes. Risk shares are always computed on total value.

shrinkage_intensity.title: Shrinkage Intensity
shrinkage_intensity.description: Weight Ledoit-Wolf puts on the constant-correlation target.

realized_volatility.title: Realized Volatility
realized_volatility.description: Realized volatility of the flow-adjusted index over the last year.

figure_basis.title: Figure Basis
figure_basis.description: The window and observation count behind each headline figure.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why there is no forecast, when there is none.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.description: Home MIC of a holding -> its country.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: Public holidays in an exchange's country not yet confirmed as closures.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: e.g. ad hoc closure, early close, holiday.

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: Sum of the reported share counts of the excluded rows.

ExpectedSessionsResponse.title: ExpectedSessionsResponse
ExpectedSessionsResponse.description:
`GET /exchange-sessions/{mic}/expected`. `basis` is one of confirmed_calendar,
partial_confirmed_calendar, weekdays_minus_configured_closures.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Who entered it. `ai` rows come from a filing passage quoted below and are replaced by the next extraction; editing one in the form makes it yours.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: The verbatim filing passage the row rests on.

key.title: Key
key.description: ISO country code, region, GICS sector or currency code; or one of __cash__, __fund_cash__, __unknown_fund_weight__, __not_looked_through__, __unclassified__.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of total portfolio value.

benchmark_weight.title: Benchmark Weight
benchmark_weight.description: The primary benchmark's weight in this bucket (its looked-through part renormalised to 100%); null for buckets it has no counterpart for.

model.title: Model
model.description: Reads annual reports for currencies and inputs.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

filings_per_run.title: Filings Per Run
filings_per_run.description: Annual reports read per run (cost guard).

extract_inputs.title: Extract Inputs
extract_inputs.description: Read currency and commodity inputs from the annual report.

extract_dependencies.title: Extract Dependencies
extract_dependencies.description: Read named customers and suppliers from the annual report; the AI approves them and the owner can overturn.

map_products.title: Map Products
map_products.description: Map reported product lines to HS trade codes (always marked estimated).

use_batch.title: Use Batch
use_batch.description: Read the run's annual reports through the provider's batch endpoint (half price, the run waits up to the time below). The answers are stored first and the usual step then finds them, so nothing else changes; a report the batch does not answer is read directly.

batch_wait_minutes.title: Batch Wait Minutes
batch_wait_minutes.description: How long a batch of annual reports is waited for.

ExposureBuildSettings.title: ExposureBuildSettings
ExposureBuildSettings.description:
The AI steps of the exposure builder. The country split from XBRL needs no AI and always
runs. Each annual report is read at most once; nothing is guessed: a figure is stored only
when a verbatim quote in the filing prints it.

ExposureContextResponse.title: ExposureContextResponse
ExposureContextResponse.description:
`GET /holdings/{ticker}/exposure-context`. Assumptions are the holding-profile
exposures dumped as JSON (a config shape, free-form here). `linked_series` are the stored
series that belong to those exposures; `unlinked` names exposures with no series.

ExposureObservation.title: ExposureObservation
ExposureObservation.description: An exposure-context price-series observation (the research row without published_at).

ExposureSeries.title: ExposureSeries
ExposureSeries.description: A stored series linked to one exposure (a commodity price or a currency fixing).

reconciles.title: Reconciles
reconciles.description: Buckets add up to the total within tolerance.

FactIndexEntry.title: FactIndexEntry
FactIndexEntry.description:
One (ticker, metric): the newest fact for it, so a search can resolve a typed metric
straight to its evidence page rather than only to the holding page.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: owner: a correction the owner entered; it wins over the extracted value.

check_score.title: Check Score
check_score.description: Passed checks / all checks stored with the figure (0..1): the share of the validator's checks it passed (`checks`). Null when no check ran.

source_tier.title: Source Tier
source_tier.description: Trust tier (1 best, 3 weakest) of the host the figure was read from: 1 for the holding's own IR or results domains, else the news_sources config's domain tier; one tier lower while the owner's feedback has the host's trust below the verification config's demote_below. Null when the host has no configured tier.

value.title: Value
value.description: For `correct`: the right value, in the fact's printed scale (the same scale as `value`, e.g. millions).

FactorAlpha.title: FactorAlpha
FactorAlpha.description: What is left of the return once the factor exposures are paid for (quant plan Q6.3).

FactsheetRow.title: FactsheetRow
FactsheetRow.description:
A `fund_factsheet` row (minus the raw `evidence` blob) with the evidence-derived
`field_names_verified`, `field_provenance` and `extraction_warnings`. Weights and charges
are fractions (JSON numbers).

audited_facts.title: Audited Facts
audited_facts.description: Facts compared with a source that matched.

annual_drag.title: Annual Drag
annual_drag.description: Share of total portfolio value per year.

unpriced_weight.title: Unpriced Weight
unpriced_weight.description: Portfolio share in funds whose expense ratio is unknown (not assumed 0).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Base currency the amounts are converted to; null before the first sync.

taxes_levies.title: Taxes Levies
taxes_levies.description: Every other fill charge (stamp duty, FTT, ...).

included_in_buys.title: Included In Buys
included_in_buys.description: Part of the fill fees that buys' amounts already include (fee_basis 'included'): subtract it from buys before showing fees separately.

included_in_sales.title: Included In Sales
included_in_sales.description: Part of the fill fees already deducted from sales' amounts: add it back to sales before showing fees separately.

unconverted.title: Unconverted
unconverted.description: Currencies of fees left out of the sums for lack of a stored FX rate.

fills_captured.title: Fills Captured
fills_captured.description: Of those, fills whose fees the sync has read.

status.title: Status
status.description: not_captured: no fill in the filtered set has had its fees read yet (stored before fee capture; the next sync re-reads the order history).

target_id.title: Target Id
target_id.description: The fact, verdict, alert, news item, story or report id.

sentence_path.title: Sentence Path
sentence_path.description: Report sentences only: where it sits in the report body, e.g. 'overview/0', 'sections/2/summary/1' (digest) or 'sentences/3' (impact note).

add_to_eval.title: Add To Eval
add_to_eval.description: With rating 'wrong' on a fact or news item: add it to the golden or labelled evaluation set with the corrected value or label.

corrected_value.title: Corrected Value
corrected_value.description: Facts: the right value, in the fact's printed scale.

corrected_value_as_written.title: Corrected Value As Written
corrected_value_as_written.description: Facts added to the golden set: the right number exactly as printed, when it differs from the stored one (e.g. '94,036').

corrected_snippet.title: Corrected Snippet
corrected_snippet.description: Facts added to the golden set: the document passage that states the right number, when the stored snippet does not contain it.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: What the feedback did: quarantined fact, verdict job, trust scores, eval candidate.

rungs.title: Rungs
rungs.description: Ladder rungs allowed, tried in order: 1 feed text, 2 polite fetch + extractor, 3 browser render, 4 official API. Empty: headline and summary only.

max_requests_per_hour.title: Max Requests Per Hour
max_requests_per_hour.description: Article page fetches per hour for this source.

retention_days.title: Retention Days
retention_days.description: Days the extracted text is kept.

display.title: Display
display.description: What the app shows of the text: full, a short excerpt, or only a link. Analysis may use more than is displayed.

FetchPolicy.title: FetchPolicy
FetchPolicy.description: How far the article-text ladder (news/fulltext.py) may go for a source's items.

before.title: Before
before.description: What the active thesis says now (empty if nothing).

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Share of inputs that were usable.

FigureBasis.title: FigureBasis
FigureBasis.description:
What one figure rests on (rule 2): its window, how many weekly observations it used and
the model behind it.

min_n.title: Min N
min_n.description: Decisions needed to judge a floor.

max_wrong_rate_increase.title: Max Wrong Rate Increase
max_wrong_rate_increase.description: Change in the wrong share a floor must achieve; negative means fewer wrong.

value.title: Value
value.description: Null when an input is missing; the reason says which.

lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: Observations first known within this many days are evaluated; older ones are never alerted (a replayed backfill raises nothing). After an outage the window reaches back to the last fully evaluated run (see max_catchup_days).

max_catchup_days.title: Max Catchup Days
max_catchup_days.description: How far back a run reaches to catch up after missed runs: the window starts at the last fully evaluated run, never earlier than this many days ago.

enforce_verification_gates.title: Enforce Verification Gates
enforce_verification_gates.description: Consult the Phase 8 gates before raising an alert: the domain reconciliation gate (credit stress, trade exposure, patents) or the signal publication gate (confirmed graph events and relationships). Without recorded audit data a gate denies, and the decision is recorded as blocked_by_gate. Turn off only for a deployment that does not run the Phase 8 verification.

throttle_hours.title: Throttle Hours
throttle_hours.description: After an alert for one rule and scope (series, holding), further alerts for the same scope within this many hours are recorded as throttled. 0: off.

trade_min_exposure_weight.title: Trade Min Exposure Weight
trade_min_exposure_weight.description: Mapped exposure weight (share of the issuer) below which a trade change is not alerted. Unmapped (unknown) weight is never counted.

trade_min_change_pct.title: Trade Min Change Pct
trade_min_change_pct.description: Year-on-year change in the trade value that alerts.

graph_event_types.title: Graph Event Types
graph_event_types.description: Confirmed company events of these types alert. Suggested or disputed ones are listed for review only.

graph_edge_types.title: Graph Edge Types
graph_edge_types.description: Confirmed company-graph edges of these types alert.

FreeSourceAlertsConfig.title: FreeSourceAlertsConfig
FreeSourceAlertsConfig.description:
Rules for the `free_source_alerts` job (credit stress, trade exposure, patent status,
confirmed company-graph events). Every decision, raised or not, is written to
`free_source_alert_trail`.

synced_at.title: Synced At
synced_at.description: When the sync that wrote this snapshot finished its last step.

prices_as_of.title: Prices As Of
prices_as_of.description: Day of the latest position snapshot: the prices and exchange rates used.

benchmark_as_of.title: Benchmark As Of
benchmark_as_of.description: Date of the benchmark's latest close.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Prices or the benchmark are older than the stale limit.

FreshnessOut.title: FreshnessOut
FreshnessOut.description: How old the data under the charts is, so a stale price or rate is visible, not implied.

unknown_weight.title: Unknown Weight
unknown_weight.description: Share of total portfolio value left unknown.

fee_drag.title: Fee Drag
fee_drag.description: weight x expense ratio, per year.

top10_weight.title: Top10 Weight
top10_weight.description: Share of net assets in the ten largest issuers.

unidentified_equity_weight.title: Unidentified Equity Weight
unidentified_equity_weight.description: Equity rows without an ISIN (matched by name only).

url.title: Url
url.description: Where the issuer publishes the PDF or page.

FundDocument.title: FundDocument
FundDocument.description:
A fund's KID, factsheet or prospectus, read for the fund's text facts (replication,
securities lending, UCITS, inception, domicile, index). Listed once; read again whenever
the document changes.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: The Trading212 ticker when the fund is held.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: cached: the latest fetch failed and this stored snapshot is shown; spreadsheet: read from the iShares full-fund download (no country, no ISIN).

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: Sum over shared issuers of the smaller fund weight.

report_period_end.title: Report Period End
report_period_end.description: The date the positions are as of.

public_after.title: Public After
public_after.description: Report date + 60 days: earliest the report is expected to be public.

lag_days.title: Lag Days
lag_days.description: Filing date minus report date, in days.

age_days.title: Age Days
age_days.description: As-of date minus report date, in days.

units.title: Units
units.description: NS shares, PA principal amount, NC contracts, ...

pct_of_fund.title: Pct Of Fund
pct_of_fund.description: Percent of the fund's net assets as filed.

map_basis.title: Map Basis
map_basis.description: Identifier that tied the row to this holding.

covered_weight.title: Covered Weight
covered_weight.description: Portfolio weight of the held funds with a figure.

fund_weight.title: Fund Weight
fund_weight.description: Portfolio weight of all held funds.

average.title: Average
average.description: Weight-averaged tracking difference over the funds with a figure.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of the portfolio; None for the proxy fund alone.

tracking_difference.title: Tracking Difference
tracking_difference.description: Annualised, fund minus benchmark, same basis and currency only.

is_proxy.title: Is Proxy
is_proxy.description: The fund the X-Ray uses as its benchmark proxy.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: As of more than 45 days ago.

url.title: Url
url.description: iShares: the product page (its embedded JSON carries the figures). Vanguard: the product-data GraphQL endpoint (e.g. https://www.vanguard.co.uk/gpx/graphql).

port_id.title: Port Id
port_id.description: Vanguard only: the fund's port id (9679 = FTSE All-World UCITS ETF Acc).

consumer_id.title: Consumer Id
consumer_id.description: Vanguard only: the site's x-consumer-id header (uk0 for vanguard.co.uk).

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Holdings whose valuation is this fund's.

index_label.title: Index Label
index_label.description: The index the fund tracks, e.g. 'S&P 500'.

benchmark_symbols.title: Benchmark Symbols
benchmark_symbols.description: Benchmark symbols (Prices config) this fund's figures stand in for.

FundValuationSource.title: FundValuationSource
FundValuationSource.description: Where an ETF's fund-level P/E and P/B are published (they stand in for its index).

source.title: Source
source.description: sec (companyfacts), sec_instance (the filing's XBRL instance) or esef (filings.xbrl.org).

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Accession number or filings.xbrl.org filing id.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Manual figures: the date they were entered for.

foreign_share.title: Foreign Share
foreign_share.description: Share of known-currency value (securities looked through plus cash) in currencies other than the base currency.

known_share.title: Known Share
known_share.description: Share of total value whose currency is known.

source.title: Source
source.description: Whose reference rates: ČNB or the ECB.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Base-currency units per one unit of `currency`.

change_pct.title: Change Pct
change_pct.description: Fraction (0.012 = +1.2 %) of the latest against the previous value.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Base-currency units per one unit of `currency`.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of the portfolio's known-currency value.

model.title: Model
model.description: Searches for facts and approves them.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: Which gaps to research. `annual_revenue` is off by default: enable it to fill the latest fiscal-year revenue of holdings with no filing data. `analyst_estimates` is recorded as unavailable (a paid vendor product) and is never searched.

use_batch.title: Use Batch
use_batch.description: Run the slots side by side and send each round of calls as one provider batch, about half the price. Only for OpenAI and Google models.

browser_fallback.title: Browser Fallback
browser_fallback.description: Retry a page in a headless browser when a plain request is refused (HTTP 403/429) or returns an empty JavaScript shell. Still obeys robots.txt and never logs in or gets past a challenge. Needs the browser build of the image.

cooldown_days.title: Cooldown Days
cooldown_days.description: Days before an unfilled slot is searched again.

min_confidence.title: Min Confidence
min_confidence.description: Below this a fact is stored for review, not approved.

t1_domains.title: T1 Domains
t1_domains.description: Regulators, registers and exchanges: accepted on their own. The company's own domains are always tier 1.

t2_domains.title: T2 Domains
t2_domains.description: Established press and wire services: dates are accepted alone, numbers need a second agreeing source.

t3_domains.title: T3 Domains
t3_domains.description: Reference sites: names and descriptions only, never a figure.

denied_domains.title: Denied Domains
denied_domains.description: Never used. Domains in no list are treated as rejected.

GapResearchSettings.title: GapResearchSettings
GapResearchSettings.description:
Filling what the structured sources left empty from reliable web pages, last resort.
Only empty, fillable slots off their cooldown are searched. Facts are kept apart from the
structured data and are approved by AI against the source tiers below.

mean_share.title: Mean Share
mean_share.description: Average share of revenue across reporting companies.

n.title: N
n.description: Companies that report revenue for this country.

value.title: Value
value.description: Matched labelled figures / all labelled figures (0..1).

target.title: Target
target.description: The evals gate's target for the component (0..1).

evaluated_at.title: Evaluated At
evaluated_at.description: When the baseline file was last written by a passing live run.

model.title: Model
model.description: The extraction model the run measured.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language, e.g. en-US, en-GB, de, cs.

country.title: Country
country.description: Edition country, e.g. US, GB, DE, CZ.

GoogleNewsLocale.title: GoogleNewsLocale
GoogleNewsLocale.description: The edition a Google News query searches (its hl, gl and ceid parameters).

GraphRow.title: GraphRow
GraphRow.description: One edge, event or disclosure; `kind` is the edge type, event type or relationship.

held_weight.title: Held Weight
held_weight.description: Share of the portfolio held in these companies.

confirmed_peer_links.title: Confirmed Peer Links
confirmed_peer_links.description: Confirmed peer links with both ends in the group.

net_debt_to_equity.description: Balance-sheet leverage, latest filed year (credit signal).

leveraged.title: Leveraged
leveraged.description: Companies with net debt above 1x equity.

value.title: Value
value.description: Null is not disclosed or not reported, never zero.

original_value.title: Original Value
original_value.description: What the first filing said, when restated.

security_type.title: Security Type
security_type.description: OpenFIGI's security type (e.g. 'Common Stock', 'ETP'); null until the reference-data job has resolved the instrument.

ppl.title: Ppl
ppl.description: Unrealised P/L in the account currency (Trading212).

contribution_base.title: Contribution Base
contribution_base.description: The holding's organic gain over the period, in base currency — its value change with its own trading netted out.

contribution_pct.title: Contribution Pct
contribution_pct.description: contribution_base as a fraction of the portfolio's total value at the start of the period; null when that value was zero.

news_gap.title: News Gap
news_gap.description: No successful news run covered it within the window.

price_symbol.title: Price Symbol
price_symbol.description: Symbol of the daily series in use (Stooq's, or Yahoo's when Stooq has none).

prices_gap.title: Prices Gap
prices_gap.description: A price symbol whose latest bar is more than 4 days old.

forward_data_provenance.title: Forward Data Provenance
forward_data_provenance.description: Source classes of forward observations (consensus, guidance, scenarios).

provenance_note.title: Provenance Note
provenance_note.default: primary = regulator, central bank, statistics office or issuer; vendor = commercial aggregator. A vendor value never replaces a primary value; disagreements are listed.

total_known.title: Total Known
total_known.description: Deals known at the date before filters.

position.description: Null when the latest sync has no position.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Fund positions from SEC N-PORT: what each fund reports holding at the report date, public about 60 days after the report date. Not beneficial ownership; do not add to Form 13F holders, 13D/G stakes or issuer-published fund holdings.

identity_error.title: Identity Error
identity_error.description: Why identity is incomplete; null when fine.

identifier_count.title: Identifier Count
identifier_count.description: All OpenFIGI listings of the share class.

parent_exceptions.title: Parent Exceptions
parent_exceptions.description: GLEIF's stated reasons that no parent is reported.

suggested.title: Suggested
suggested.description: Waiting for the owner to confirm.

disputed.title: Disputed
disputed.description: A tier-3 claim a tier-1 source contradicts; `conflict` holds the other source's version. Waiting for the owner.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Yahoo symbol; null when none is known.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Intraday prices are on (Config -> Jobs -> Prices).

available.title: Available
available.description: Intraday bars or a last price are stored.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: intraday: a last trade during the session; close: the session's close.

last_trade_time.title: Last Trade Time
last_trade_time.description: Time of the last price, exchange time.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Quote currency as Yahoo reports it (GBp = pence).

session_date.title: Session Date
session_date.description: Exchange-local day of the last price.

note.title: Note
note.description: Why intraday prices are missing or stale (the page shows daily closes).

top_holders_previous_period.title: Top Holders Previous Period
top_holders_previous_period.description: The period each top holder's prev_shares is from.

applicable.title: Applicable
applicable.description: False for holdings Form 13F cannot cover (non-US listings).

shares_outstanding.description: The denominator of the % figures, with its source.

pct_of_shares_outstanding.title: Pct Of Shares Outstanding
pct_of_shares_outstanding.description: Aggregate institutional %: the latest period's figure.

basis_label.title: Basis Label
basis_label.description: What the % measures, e.g. "US 13F filers' holdings of the US line - a floor" for ADRs.

HoldingPeriodRow.title: HoldingPeriodRow
HoldingPeriodRow.description: An open purchase lot with both dates of the holding-period test (plan M4.8).

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Symbol of the daily series (Stooq's, or Yahoo's when Stooq has none); null when none is known.

source.title: Source
source.description: Whose daily closes; null when none are stored.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Date of the latest stored close.

day_change_pct.title: Day Change Pct
day_change_pct.description: Fraction (0.012 = +1.2 %) of the latest against the previous value.

bars.title: Bars
bars.description: Daily closes from `days` before `as_of` to `as_of`, oldest first; empty when no prices are stored.

intraday.description: The latest intraday quote when intraday prices are on and one is stored (it may be newer than `as_of`).

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other and former names, used to match news.

results_urls.title: Results Urls
results_urls.description: Pages where results press releases or reports are published.

financial_calendar_url.title: Financial Calendar Url
financial_calendar_url.description: IR financial calendar page with upcoming report dates.

extra_domains.title: Extra Domains
extra_domains.description: Further domains the earnings check may search and fetch from (the IR and results URLs' domains are always allowed).

sec_cik.title: Sec Cik
sec_cik.description: SEC Central Index Key. US issuers (8-K) and foreign issuers that furnish results on 6-K. Looked up from the ticker when empty.

sec_ticker.title: Sec Ticker
sec_ticker.description: Ticker as EDGAR and Finnhub list it, when it differs from the Trading212 ticker's prefix.

alpha_vantage_symbol.title: Alpha Vantage Symbol
alpha_vantage_symbol.description: Alpha Vantage exchange symbol for fallback fundamentals (for example TSCO.LON or MBG.DEX). When empty, the EDGAR ticker is tried.

fmp_symbol.title: Fmp Symbol
fmp_symbol.description: Financial Modeling Prep symbol for the profile and estimates refresh. When empty, the EDGAR ticker (sec_ticker) is used; with neither, FMP is not called.

companies_house_number.title: Companies House Number
companies_house_number.description: UK Companies House company number (8 characters, e.g. 00102498 or SC123456). Enables the Companies House profile and filing-history refresh.

edinet_code.title: Edinet Code
edinet_code.description: EDINET code of a Japanese filer (E followed by five digits, e.g. E02144). Enables the EDINET filing-list refresh.

fiscal_year_end_month.title: Fiscal Year End Month
fiscal_year_end_month.description: Month the fiscal year ends in (Apple: 9, Microsoft: 6). Maps fiscal quarters to calendar periods.

price_symbol.title: Price Symbol
price_symbol.description: Stooq symbol for price history when the one derived from OpenFIGI is wrong or missing (e.g. 'sap.de').

yahoo_symbol.title: Yahoo Symbol
yahoo_symbol.description: Yahoo Finance symbol (intraday prices, and daily prices when Stooq has none) when the one derived from the listing is wrong or missing (e.g. 'NOVO-B.CO').

eodhd_symbol.title: Eodhd Symbol
eodhd_symbol.description: Exact EODHD exchange:symbol code, including its verified exchange suffix (for example AAPL.US). Used only after exchange-list verification.

reporting_currency.title: Reporting Currency
reporting_currency.description: Currency the company reports in; figures in another are held.

valuation_source.title: Valuation Source
valuation_source.description: Which fundamentals the valuation uses: 'auto' takes the freshest automatic source (SEC XBRL, then ESEF) and the manual figures only when there is none; 'sec', 'esef' or 'manual' force one.

manual_fundamentals.description: Hand-entered per-share figures for holdings without an automatic source.

executives.title: Executives
executives.description: Named executives (CEO, CFO, chair). News naming one links to the holding.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Product and brand names that are not part of the company name.

manual_segments.title: Manual Segments
manual_segments.description: Revenue by region / segment / product entered by hand; shown only when no SEC XBRL breakdown exists for the holding.

HoldingProfilesConfig.title: HoldingProfilesConfig
HoldingProfilesConfig.description: All holding profiles. Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `holding_profiles`.

HoldingReturnResult.title: HoldingReturnResult
HoldingReturnResult.description:
Returns of the chosen price series over one window. Returns and coverage are fractions
(JSON numbers); a null return carries its reason.

HoldingReturnsResponse.title: HoldingReturnsResponse
HoldingReturnsResponse.description:
`GET /holdings/{ticker}/returns` (use exclude_unset: `reason` appears only when there is
no stored price series).

total_revenue.title: Total Revenue
total_revenue.description: The filing's undimensioned revenue for the period (a breakdown can sum to less: hedging gains, unallocated items).

history.title: History
history.description: Per breakdown, the same-basis periods stored, oldest first (at most 8).

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Filing date (SEC) or period end (manual).

ads_ratio.title: Ads Ratio
ads_ratio.description: Home-market shares one priced share represents (TSMC's ADS = 5); per-share figures are multiplied by it.

ads_ratio_source.title: Ads Ratio Source
ads_ratio_source.description: Where the ratio comes from: the holding profile's share basis, the ratio the 20-F states (SEC XBRL job), the documented default, or 1.

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: Other sources or accounting bases, for comparison (not used).

pe_history.title: Pe History
pe_history.description: Weekly P/E over two years: each close over the EPS TTM in force then (from the first filing of each period); empty when it cannot be built.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: The last refresh's error per source, if any.

checked_at.title: Checked At
checked_at.description: When the refresh job last ran for it.

holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.description: Every open position of the latest snapshot, by value descending.

holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.description: Every open position once, by value descending.

residual_weight.title: Residual Weight
residual_weight.description: 1 - the published rows; unknown, never spread over the known rows.

imbalance_before.title: Imbalance Before
imbalance_before.description: Distance of the style tilts from the benchmark, before.

relief.title: Relief
relief.description: Before minus after: positive means the idea moves the book towards the benchmark's style.

dominant_factor.title: Dominant Factor
dominant_factor.description: The style factor with the largest tilt before the idea.

method.title: Method
method.default: The idea is added to a copy of today's holdings at the stated weight, paid for from cash, and the factor regressions of the Factors page are run again. Relief is the distance of the style tilts from the benchmark before minus after (the Euclidean norm of the market, size, value, profitability, investment and momentum tilts). Positive relief means the idea moves the book towards the benchmark's style.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: Company symbols from the event to the holding.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Portfolio share in the holding (exposure, not a return forecast); null for a hypothesis.

attribute_weight.title: Attribute Weight
attribute_weight.description: Portfolio share in holdings the story reaches only through a shared sector, country, currency, commodity or rate classification (no supply-chain link).

unchanged.title: Unchanged
unchanged.description: Domains whose body equalled the active version.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model of the agent run.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: Triggers older than this are not picked up.

max_per_scan.title: Max Per Scan
max_per_scan.description: Runs one scan may queue, newest trigger first.

min_severity.title: Min Severity
min_severity.description: Alerts below this severity start no run.

InboxSettings.title: InboxSettings
InboxSettings.description:
Event-driven agents: each new escalation note or thesis-breach alert starts one bounded
run that reads the app's records and leaves an inbox item with the evidence and at most
one proposed action. A run never trades, never edits a thesis and never starts a job: the
owner confirms a proposed action in the inbox.

Incident.title: Incident
Incident.description:
A story the owner may need to look at: a severe one nobody was alerted to, or an alert
the owner marked as not useful.

index_weight_listed.title: Index Weight Listed
index_weight_listed.description: Sum of the pasted index weights.

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: The pasted weights cover less than the whole index.

index_weight_held.title: Index Weight Held
index_weight_held.description: Index weight in names the portfolio also holds.

unmatched.title: Unmatched
unmatched.description: Pasted constituents that no holding matched.

last_close.title: Last Close
last_close.description: The latest value: a close, or the intraday value when `kind` is intraday.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Day of the latest value (exchange-local).

as_of_time.title: As Of Time
as_of_time.description: When the latest value was computed (UTC), when known.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: intraday: a value during the session; close: a close.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the latest value is from.

change_pct.title: Change Pct
change_pct.description: Fraction (0.012 = +1.2 %) of the latest against the previous value.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Where the figures came from (a web address).

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The date the figures describe.

reported_share_count_change.title: Reported Share Count Change
reported_share_count_change.description: Fractional change between the two latest reported share counts; not a motive.

plan_trades_excluded.title: Plan Trades Excluded
plan_trades_excluded.description: Rule 10b5-1 plan trades, kept out of the net.

plan_unknown_trades.title: Plan Unknown Trades
plan_unknown_trades.description: In the net, but the filing has no plan flag.

bundled_sales_excluded.title: Bundled Sales Excluded
bundled_sales_excluded.description: Sales bundled with a same-day exercise.

raw_transaction_code.title: Raw Transaction Code
raw_transaction_code.description: As reported on the form. Not a signal; read economic_class.

footnote.title: Footnote
footnote.description: Footnote text the form attached to this line.

plan_basis.title: Plan Basis
plan_basis.description: Where the Rule 10b5-1 flag was read from.

percent_of_outstanding.title: Percent Of Outstanding
percent_of_outstanding.description: Shares as a percent of the share count known at the date; null if unknown.

time.title: Time
time.description: Start of the bar in exchange time, HH:MM.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: intraday: a last trade during the session; close: the session's close.

time_local.title: Time Local
time_local.description: HH:MM in the exchange's time zone.

change_pct.title: Change Pct
change_pct.description: Fraction (0.012 = +1.2 %) of the latest against the previous value.

IntradayQuote.title: IntradayQuote
IntradayQuote.description: The latest stored Yahoo quote of a holding's listing (Yahoo Finance, unofficial).

model.title: Model
model.description: Searches for the pages and approves them.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

max_searches.title: Max Searches
max_searches.description: Web searches per holding, the expensive part.

use_batch.title: Use Batch
use_batch.description: Run the holdings side by side and send each round of calls (all the searches, then all the judgements) as one provider batch, about half the price. Only for OpenAI and Google models; the run waits for the batch.

probe_first.title: Probe First
probe_first.description: Before the web search, try common investor-relations paths on the domains the holding profile already names; search only when none loads a page naming the company.

browser_fallback.title: Browser Fallback
browser_fallback.description: Retry a page in a headless browser when a plain request is refused (HTTP 403/429) or returns an empty JavaScript shell. Still obeys robots.txt and never logs in or gets past a challenge. Needs the browser build of the image.

cooldown_days.title: Cooldown Days
cooldown_days.description: Days before a holding without a result is retried.

min_confidence.title: Min Confidence
min_confidence.description: Below this a page is not applied (it stays in the decision log).

denied_domains.title: Denied Domains
denied_domains.description: Domains never accepted as an investor page.

robots_exempt_domains.title: Robots Exempt Domains
robots_exempt_domains.description: Investor sites whose robots.txt is not applied when their pages are read for discovery. Your decision per site: requests still go to public addresses only, are spaced out, state who is asking, never log in and never get past a challenge. Leave empty to obey robots.txt everywhere.

IrDiscoverySettings.title: IrDiscoverySettings
