IrDiscoverySettings.description:
Finding each holding's investor-relations pages by web search, checking them, and having
AI approve them. Pages the owner already set are never changed.

legal_name.title: Legal Name
legal_name.description: The legal name on that date, if one was known.

merged_securities.title: Merged Securities
merged_securities.description: Distinct securities merged into this issuer.

overlap_weight.title: Overlap Weight
overlap_weight.description: Exposure supplied by more than one channel: weight minus the largest single channel.

IssuerGroup.title: IssuerGroup
IssuerGroup.description:
Securities of one issuer counted together in the top underlying holdings (an ADR and
its ordinary share, two share classes).

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure the link is: 1 for the source or an identifier, lower for a name, lowest for a competitor, supplier, customer or topic. Null before N5.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Times the runner started this job, a resumed run included; above 1 means it was retried. 0 = never started.

next_before_id.title: Next Before Id
next_before_id.description: Pass as before_id for the next page.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Times the runner started this job, a resumed run included; above 1 means it was retried. 0 = never started.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Sum of the run's step costs; null if none.

failed_step.title: Failed Step
failed_step.description: The first failed step's name, if any.

cron.title: Cron
cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday).

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Runs with at least one costed step in the month.

job_cap_usd.title: Job Cap Usd
job_cap_usd.description: The cap of one run of this type, if any.

critical.title: Critical
critical.description: Keeps running at the monthly cap.

cache_hit_rate.title: Cache Hit Rate
cache_hit_rate.description: Cache-read tokens / all input tokens of the month's steps; a silent drop means a prompt prefix stopped being stable. Null: no input tokens.

catch_up_on_start.title: Catch Up On Start
catch_up_on_start.description: On worker start, run the data jobs that never succeeded or missed their last scheduled run, one at a time in dependency order.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Per-provider refresh interval and hard free-tier budgets. A provider is used whenever it is available (its API key is set, or it needs none).

portfolio_sync.description: Trading212 sync, FX rates and drift. Default: daily at 22:30 Prague time.

earnings_calendar.description: Refresh the report date of holdings reporting soon (see earnings_calendar_settings.refresh_within_days). Default: Sundays 06:00.

earnings_calendar_full.description: Refresh every holding's report date from its IR calendar. Default: quarterly, 1 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct 05:00.

earnings_due.description: Queue earnings checks for holdings that reported. Default: daily 08:00.

fact_reconcile.description: Check stored results figures against the issuers' 10-Q/10-K XBRL. Default: daily 09:00.

reference_data.description: Identity, listings, legal entities and group structure. Default: Mondays 04:30.

price_history.description: Daily prices (Stooq) and FX history after the close. Default: weekdays 23:15.

holiday_refresh.description: Public holidays for last, this and next year. Default: 2 January and 2 July.

macro_collect.description: FRED, ECB and Eurostat macro series; macro surprises on release days. Default: daily 11:30 (after Eurostat's 11:00 releases).

public_data_collect.description: Curated World Bank, OECD, BIS and UN Comtrade releases. A source is skipped until the source audit has verified its access. Default: Sundays 04:00.

source_audit.description: Probe every free endpoint once (one request each, inside its free quota) and record whether it is available, so the collectors use it. Also runs at worker start when a key was added or changed. Default: Mondays 03:00.

monitor.description: Alert on failed jobs, missed runs and coverage gaps. Default: every 15 minutes.

news_ingest.description: Ingest, classify, corroborate and alert. Default: every 2 h, 06:00-22:00.

daily_digest.description: Daily digest of the last 24 h. Default: weekdays 07:00.

weekly_digest.description: Weekly digest of the last 7 days. Default: Sundays 18:00.

monthly_review.description: Monthly review on the first weekday of the month (a scheduled run on another day does nothing). Default: 07:00 on the 1st-3rd.

ownership_13f.description: Load new SEC Form 13F data sets (published quarterly). Default: the 5th of each month, 05:00.

insider_trades.description: Load structured SEC Forms 3, 4 and 5 for portfolio issuers. Default: daily 06:30.

control_stakes.description: Load Schedule 13D/G beneficial-ownership filings for portfolio issuers. Default: daily 06:45.

nport_holdings.description: Load public SEC N-PORT fund holdings for held US funds. Default: Sat 05:15.

fund_probes.description: Probe optional Finnhub/FMP fund endpoints for free access. Default: Sundays 04:00.

fund_characteristics_audit.description: Check iShares/Vanguard fund valuation figures for parser drift. Default: daily 07:30.

fund_issuer_facts.description: Read each held fund's own issuer data (iShares product-data API, WisdomTree factsheet): replication, launch date, domicile, UCITS status, benchmark index and the published NAV. Writes a fact only when it changed and never over a value you recorded from another source. Default: weekdays 08:15.

free_source_alerts.description: Evaluate credit, trade, patent and graph alerts. Default: daily 12:05.

change_alerts.description: Alert on a tier 1 deal story or a new patent family at a holding, once each. Default: daily 07:55.

shadow_snapshot.description: Record the daily free-source shadow-run snapshot. Default: daily 23:50.

shadow_report.description: Generate the free-source shadow-run report. Default: Monday 08:00.

raw_retention.description: Blanks old raw payloads (normalized data stays) and deletes fetch-audit rows past the horizon. Default: daily 03:15.

research_trace_retention.description: Deletes the checkpoints and tool traces of research and chat jobs that succeeded more than `research.trace_retention_days` ago (reports stay). Default: daily 03:40.

zero_cost_gate.description: Audits the access ledger and the budgets collectors pass to the governor against the free quotas; reads only. Default: daily 03:20.

returns_refresh.description: Compute and store price and total returns for held securities. Default: weekdays 23:45.

exchange_probes.description: Probe free price endpoints per exchange (one held symbol each). Default: the 2nd of each month, 05:00.

ir_releases.description: Fetch and version registered issuer IR pages (guidance, consensus, capital return). Default: daily 07:20.

sec_fsds_backfill.description: Backfill statements and notes from the SEC Financial Statement and Notes datasets. Off by default.

pdmr_uk.description: Parse UK PDMR (MAR Art.19) notifications from the RNS stream. Off by default (retrieval unverified).

graph_review.description: Review SEC relationship candidates, extract deal events and reconcile parent changes. Default: daily 07:40.

fmp_company.description: FMP free tier: company profile (sector, industry) and annual analyst estimates of holdings that map an EDGAR/Finnhub ticker. Runs when FMP_API_KEY is set and the endpoint probe passed. At most two requests per holding, inside the provider's daily budget.

alpha_vantage_statements.description: Alpha Vantage annual statements of holdings with a confirmed listing and an explicit symbol mapping, stalest first, a few per run so the shared 25-a-day budget keeps its reserve. Runs when ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY is set.

epo_patents.description: EPO OPS patent-family refresh for the stalest holdings (a few per run). Runs when the OPS client credentials are set.

companies_house_filings.description: Companies House company profile and filing history of UK holdings whose profile has a companies_house_number. Runs when COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY is set. Two requests per holding, at most 20 holdings a run.

edinet_filings.description: EDINET (Japan FSA) document list of the last days, kept for holdings whose profile has an edinet_code (list and links only, no XBRL parsing). Runs when EDINET_API_KEY is set.

twelve_data_corporate_actions.description: Twelve Data dividends and splits of holdings with a confirmed listing, stored as suggested corporate actions for the owner to confirm. Runs when TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY is set. A few holdings per run inside the Basic plan's credits; a plan denial latches the endpoint as paid-only.

valuation_refresh.description: Fundamentals (SEC XBRL, ESEF) of holdings that filed since the last read (all of them weekly) and the ETF providers' fund P/E and P/B. Default: daily 07:45.

etf_look_through.description: ETF look-through: the funds' holdings from iShares and Vanguard, skipped when the as-of date has not moved. Default: Saturdays 06:40.

sec_xbrl.description: Shares outstanding and revenue by region / segment from the holdings' latest SEC XBRL filings; only filings not parsed yet are downloaded. Default: Tuesdays 05:40.

ai_approvals.description: AI approval of suggested listings and peers (and the Finnhub peer refresh that feeds it). The owner can overturn any decision. Default: daily 07:10.

ir_discovery.description: Finds investor-relations pages for holdings that have none (web search, checked and approved by AI). Default: Mondays 07:30.

news_ai_search.description: Asks a search-capable model for recent news on holdings the wire covers thinly. Results are leads at the lowest tier: they never alert on their own. On by default (it spends on web searches, within the budget). Default: daily 06:20.

news_triage.description: Triages new wire items on a cheap model: relevance, topic, entities and a one-line gloss. On by default (it spends on a model, within the budget). Default: hourly at :10.

news_analysis.description: Analyses new stories: novelty, threads, market context and themes in code, plus the model techniques selected in the news settings. Default: every 3 hours.

news_brief.description: Writes the morning brief (and on Mondays the weekly brief and the per-holding briefs) from stored stories, each line citing its items. On by default (it spends on a model). Default: daily 06:30.

gap_research.description: Searches reliable web pages for facts the structured sources left empty (next report date, shares outstanding, description); AI approves them. Default: Wednesdays 08:00.

exposure_build.description: Builds each holding's revenue-by-country exposure from its latest annual SEC XBRL filing (reported basis). Your own exposure entries are never changed. Default: Tuesdays 05:50.

document_index.description: Splits new filings, reports, theses, notes and news into passages and embeds them for document search. Default: daily 03:20.

autopilot.description: The autopilot: settles the review queues (held facts, graph edges, disclosure reviews, ...) with rules and models, logs every decision and escalates what it cannot settle. Default: every six hours at :20.

watchdog.description: The ops watchdog: retries failed collectors, re-runs the refresh behind a data-quality issue, lifts old provider blocks, and tells you which API key is missing or when the AI budget will run out. Default: hourly at :10.

autopilot_calibration.description: Compares the autopilot's decisions with the owner's calls and a stronger model's audit, then promotes or demotes each kind. Default: Sundays 07:40.

inbox_scan.description: Looks for new escalation notes and thesis-breach alerts and queues an agent run for each, which leaves an inbox item. Default: hourly at :10.

factor_returns.description: Downloads the Ken French Data Library daily factor returns (market, size, value, profitability, investment, momentum) for the Developed, Europe and US markets, which the factor exposures use. The library adds a month at a time. Default: Mondays 05:30.

disclosure_sources.description: Re-test every disclosure source, store the result, switch a failing one off and the SEC sources on when they pass. Default: daily 06:00.

disclosure_ingest.description: Fetch, store and parse the newest SEC annual and quarterly filings of held issuers. Skips itself until the SEC sources pass their access test. Default: weekdays 06:40.

disclosure_identifiers.description: Suggest missing LEIs (GLEIF) and FIGIs (OpenFIGI); you confirm each. Default: Saturdays 06:20.

disclosure_deals.description: Read the recent 8-K, 6-K, S-4, proxy and tender-offer filings of held issuers and store the deals, states and terms they state. Default: weekdays 06:50.

disclosure_esef.description: Read the filings.xbrl.org index for held issuers with a confirmed LEI and store each new ESEF report as a dated document version. Default: weekdays 07:00.

disclosure_estimates.description: Fetch each enabled issuer consensus file once and store a new version only when its bytes changed. Default: weekdays 06:30.

disclosure_alerts.description: Scan verified disclosures for new alerts and e-mail them, grouped by ticker, when e-mail is configured. Default: daily 13:15.

fund_documents.title: Fund Documents
fund_documents.description: Fund documents to read for facts the issuer readers do not cover (any issuer except iShares and WisdomTree). The daily fund facts job reads the new or changed ones; every fact must quote the document word for word.

JobsConfig.title: JobsConfig
JobsConfig.description:
Schedules for the worker's timed jobs. Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `jobs`.

The worker re-reads this every few minutes, so a saved change applies without a restart.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: The entry this one reviews; its reasons stay untouched.

price_at_decision.title: Price At Decision
price_at_decision.description: Defaults to the latest stored price.

thesis_return.title: Thesis Return
thesis_return.description: Return to the thesis sell target, annualised.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Weight on the thesis return; from the thesis's conviction.

expected_return.title: Expected Return
expected_return.description: Thesis and equilibrium returns blended by the confidence.

bound.title: Bound
bound.description: Upper bound, share of the portfolio.

item_id.title: Item Id
item_id.description: The item whose text contains the span.

span.title: Span
span.description: Verbatim quote from that item's text supporting the claim.

history.title: History
history.description: Latest verdict per period, newest first.

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: Null when the filing gives no share count; not zero.

report_date.title: Report Date
report_date.description: The date the figure is measured on.

fees_excluded.title: Fees Excluded
fees_excluded.description: Fills whose fee lines in another currency than the fill were left out.

unexplained_cash.title: Unexplained Cash
unexplained_cash.description: Sum of unexplained daily cash changes.

backtest_flags.title: Backtest Flags
backtest_flags.description: Why this subject should not feed a performance/backtest unreviewed.

status.title: Status
status.description: confirmed, or suggested until you confirm it

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: The items and results behind it.

change.title: Change
change.description: new, deeper, still_open, eased or cleared.

listing_id.title: Listing Id
listing_id.description: Another listing of the same security, instead of the derived.

ListingRef.title: ListingRef
ListingRef.description: The canonical listing; every column but `id` can be null (left join).

LookThroughAsOfResponse.title: LookThroughAsOfResponse
LookThroughAsOfResponse.description: `GET /funds/look-through`: the base report plus the snapshot ids it rests on.

portfolio_id.title: Portfolio Id
portfolio_id.description: The issuer's fund id: the iShares product/portfolio id (CSPX 253743) or the Vanguard Europe port id (VWCE 9679).

LookThroughFund.title: LookThroughFund
LookThroughFund.description: A fund whose holdings are read from its issuer. Matched to a position by ISIN.

available.title: Available
available.description: At least one held fund is looked through.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Fetch from the issuers (off: stored snapshots are still shown).

funds.title: Funds
funds.description: Funds looked through, by ISIN: provider and the issuer's fund id.

benchmark_proxies.title: Benchmark Proxies
benchmark_proxies.description: The benchmark's constituents are proxied by this fund's holdings (equity lines renormalised to 100%). A proxy fund is fetched even when it is not held.

issuer_groups.title: Issuer Groups
issuer_groups.description: ISINs of one issuer counted together in the top underlying holdings.

direct_sectors.title: Direct Sectors
direct_sectors.description: Sector of a directly held stock when no fund holds the same ISIN and the strategy's sector bucket is not a GICS sector.

direct_countries.title: Direct Countries
direct_countries.description: Country of a directly held stock, overriding its home market.

ishares_spreadsheet_fallback.title: Ishares Spreadsheet Fallback
ishares_spreadsheet_fallback.description: When the holdings JSON fails and no recent snapshot is stored, read the full-fund download (no country or ISIN column).

cached_fallback_days.title: Cached Fallback Days
cached_fallback_days.description: On a failed fetch, a stored snapshot this recent is kept in use instead of trying the spreadsheet fallback.

stale_after_days.title: Stale After Days
stale_after_days.description: A snapshot older than this is labelled stale (Vanguard publishes month-end data a few weeks late).

LookThroughSettings.title: LookThroughSettings
LookThroughSettings.description:
ETF look-through: holdings of the funds the portfolio holds, from the issuers'
(undocumented) data endpoints, stored weekly as dated snapshots.

months_to_test.title: Months To Test
months_to_test.description: 0 once the lot has passed the test.

near_test.title: Near Test
near_test.description: Not passed, and passes within the warning window: waiting may keep the exemption.

history_years.title: History Years
history_years.description: Years of history loaded the first time a series is collected (later runs fetch only the recent observations, and fill any gap since the last stored one).

geos.title: Geos
geos.description: Eurostat areas: countries and the euro area (EA21 from 2026).

cnb.title: Cnb
cnb.description: ČNB rates. CZEONIA is the risk-free rate of the Sharpe ratio (series key 'czeonia'); the repo rate's changes are ČNB decisions.

MacroSettings.title: MacroSettings
MacroSettings.description: Macro series collected into `macro_series` (numbers in digests come only from here).

value.title: Value
value.description: The number as written, or null.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit or currency as written, or null.

text.title: Text
text.description: The figure as it appears in the text.

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: New: shares held; exited: shares held before.

performance_note.title: Performance Note
performance_note.default: 13F quarter-end value changes are not investment returns. Historical prices and complete security mapping are not available to calculate comparable performance.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.default: private: returned to the owner who asked; not stored or shared

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Each part of the report and the denominator it covers.

figure_sources.title: Figure Sources
figure_sources.description: For each figure in the report, where its value comes from.

eps_ttm.title: Eps Ttm
eps_ttm.description: Diluted earnings per share over the trailing twelve months (or the latest full year), per ordinary share.

book_value_per_share.title: Book Value Per Share
book_value_per_share.description: Equity attributable to shareholders per ordinary share.

dividend_per_share.title: Dividend Per Share
dividend_per_share.description: Dividends per ordinary share paid over the last year.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Period end (or date) the figures are for.

source_note.title: Source Note
source_note.description: Where the figures come from, e.g. 'Annual report 2025, p. 112'.

ManualFundamentals.title: ManualFundamentals
ManualFundamentals.description:
Per-share figures entered by hand, for a holding no automatic source covers (e.g.
Prague listings, whose filings are not machine-readable). Shown as "entered manually".

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the figure comes from, e.g. 'Annual Report 2025, segment note, p. 212'.

ManualSegmentRow.title: ManualSegmentRow
ManualSegmentRow.description:
Revenue for one region, segment or product, entered by hand from an annual report
(for issuers whose filings carry no machine-readable breakdown, e.g. CEZ and KB).

label.title: Label
label.default: Estimate from your mapping, not a reported figure

base_currency.title: Base Currency
base_currency.description: The latest snapshot's base currency (the active strategy's before the first sync).

fx.title: Fx
fx.description: Each currency held in the latest snapshot (positions and the account) other than the base currency, by code.

indices.title: Indices
indices.description: The Jobs config's `prices.market_strip`, in its order.

yahoo_symbol.title: Yahoo Symbol
yahoo_symbol.description: Yahoo Finance symbol of the same index (^GSPC, ^STOXX): intraday values, and closes when Stooq has none. Empty: the known counterpart of the Stooq symbol.

values.title: Values
values.description: Revenue per period label; null = not reported that period.

latest_share.title: Latest Share
latest_share.description: Share of operating revenue before eliminations.

change.title: Change
change.description: Latest against the previous period, only when both are reported.

day.title: Day
day.description: First day the new ticker applies.

MergerEntry.title: MergerEntry
MergerEntry.description:
A share-exchange merger you entered: each old share became `ratio` new shares. Earlier
fills of the old ticker are carried over to the new one with their cost and purchase date.

needs_provider.title: Needs Provider
needs_provider.description: Optional provider whose key this metric depends on; null = key-free.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the value is unknown or not meaningful.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: None when the model has no price.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Re-asks the run made. The HTTP client's own retries are not visible here.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: openai or google, from the model id.

web_search_per_1000.title: Web Search Per 1000
web_search_per_1000.description: Overrides the global price of 1,000 web searches.

method.title: Method
method.default: At each past week the volatility of today's holdings is forecast from the weeks before it (zero-mean exponentially weighted, half-life 26 weeks). A week is a hit when the portfolio falls by more than the 95 % or 99 % value-at-risk of that forecast. Kupiec's test checks the number of hits, Christoffersen's whether they cluster; the standard deviation of the weekly return divided by its forecast should be 1.

review_item.title: Review Item
review_item.description: Set when a test failed: what to look at.

alert_failed_jobs.title: Alert Failed Jobs
alert_failed_jobs.description: Job types whose failed runs alert (once per run).

stuck_run_minutes.title: Stuck Run Minutes
stuck_run_minutes.description: A run still going after this long alerts once (0: off). The largest jobs (13F loads, backfills) take an hour or more, so keep it above that.

missed_run_grace_minutes.title: Missed Run Grace Minutes
missed_run_grace_minutes.description: A scheduled run that has not succeeded this long after its slot is missed.

news_coverage_hours.title: News Coverage Hours
news_coverage_hours.description: A holding with no successful news run this long raises a coverage alert.

MonitorSettings.title: MonitorSettings
MonitorSettings.description: Monitoring: failed jobs, missed scheduled runs and per-holding coverage gaps alert.

premium.title: Premium
premium.description: Listing close / NAV - 1; positive is a premium.

nav_change.title: Nav Change
nav_change.description: Last NAV / first NAV - 1 between your entered dates; excludes distributions.

net_value.title: Net Value
net_value.description: Bought minus sold at the reported prices; null unless every counted row has a price.

plan_status_unknown_rows.title: Plan Status Unknown Rows
plan_status_unknown_rows.description: Counted rows whose Rule 10b5-1 status the form does not state.

plan_possible_rows.title: Plan Possible Rows
plan_possible_rows.description: Counted rows whose filing ticks the Rule 10b5-1 check box: some transaction in the filing was planned, the form does not say which.

by_ownership.title: By Ownership
by_ownership.description: Net shares by direct / indirect / unknown ownership.

next_before_id.title: Next Before Id
next_before_id.description: Pass as before_id for the next page.

next_ingest_due_at.title: Next Ingest Due At
next_ingest_due_at.description: The scheduled news check after the last one: the feed is stale once this has passed (plus a margin) with no newer check. Null when the job is disabled.

sentiment_score.title: Sentiment Score
sentiment_score.description: Provider sentiment signal; candidate ranking only.

sentiment_relevance.title: Sentiment Relevance
sentiment_relevance.description: Provider ticker relevance for the sentiment signal.

NewsLabel.title: NewsLabel
NewsLabel.description: The right classification of a news item, for the labelled set.

classification_effort.title: Classification Effort
classification_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

rules_first_classification.title: Rules First Classification
rules_first_classification.description: Settle in code, without the model, a watch-topic hit linked to holdings only through the topic term (other, not relevant) and a headline that repeats an already classified one with the same candidate holdings (it takes that label). Measured on the stored wire: 598 of 598 and 87 of 87 matched the model.

classification_use_batch.title: Classification Use Batch
classification_use_batch.description: Send a run's classification calls through the provider's batch API (half price, answers within minutes to hours) when the model is an OpenAI or Google one. A group the batch does not answer is classified directly. Off: every call is direct, so a severe item is labelled at once.

classification_batch_wait_minutes.title: Classification Batch Wait Minutes
classification_batch_wait_minutes.description: How long a classification batch is waited for.

corroboration_effort.title: Corroboration Effort
corroboration_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

corroboration_rounds.title: Corroboration Rounds
corroboration_rounds.description: Corroboration searches per story: one when it is first seen, the rest spread over the re-check window.

recheck_hours.title: Recheck Hours
recheck_hours.description: How long an unconfirmed story is re-checked.

edgar_fts_max_hits.title: Edgar Fts Max Hits
edgar_fts_max_hits.description: Most EDGAR full-text search hits read per query (100 per request; EDGAR serves at most 10,000). A query with more is noted in the collect step.

translation_model.title: Translation Model
translation_model.description: Translates the headline and summary of non-English wire items to English (the original is kept). A cheap model: the work is volume, not judgement.

translation_effort.title: Translation Effort
translation_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

translation_per_run.title: Translation Per Run
translation_per_run.description: Items translated per run (0: no translation); linked items first.

search_lead_model.title: Search Lead Model
search_lead_model.description: The model that web-searches for recent news on thinly covered holdings.

search_lead_effort.title: Search Lead Effort
search_lead_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

ai_search_provider.title: Ai Search Provider
ai_search_provider.description: Who finds the leads: 'model' (the search model's built-in web search) or 'brave' (a plain search API for the links, at a fraction of the fee; needs BRAVE_API_KEY, and the model then only drops pages that are not about the company). Switch only after the lead-recall check against the model path.

ai_search_max_searches.title: Ai Search Max Searches
ai_search_max_searches.description: Web searches per holding per run.

ai_search_thin_below.title: Ai Search Thin Below
ai_search_thin_below.description: A holding is searched when the wire has fewer than this many items for it in the window.

ai_search_days.title: Ai Search Days
ai_search_days.description: How far back leads are asked for, and the window.

analysis_techniques.title: Analysis Techniques
analysis_techniques.description: The analysis techniques that run. The default four are computed in code and cost nothing; the others call a model (extraction first: impact chains, framing, claim checks and thesis links read its output).

extraction_model.title: Extraction Model
extraction_model.description: Extracts the typed event (actors, magnitude, claims with cited spans) from a story's stored text.

extraction_effort.title: Extraction Effort
extraction_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

analysis_model.title: Analysis Model
analysis_model.description: Writes impact chains, framing comparisons, claim checks and thesis links.

analysis_effort.title: Analysis Effort
analysis_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

brief_model.title: Brief Model
brief_model.description: Writes the morning and weekly briefs.

brief_effort.title: Brief Effort
brief_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

analysis_per_run.title: Analysis Per Run
analysis_per_run.description: Stories analysed by the model techniques per run (0: none); the most severe and newest first.

analysis_min_severity.title: Analysis Min Severity
analysis_min_severity.description: Stories below this severity are not sent to a model for analysis.

framing_min_outlets.title: Framing Min Outlets
framing_min_outlets.description: A framing comparison needs this many independent outlets on the story.

novelty_window_days.title: Novelty Window Days
novelty_window_days.description: How far back a story is compared for novelty.

novelty_repeat_similarity.title: Novelty Repeat Similarity
novelty_repeat_similarity.description: Cosine similarity at or above which a story repeats an earlier one.

novelty_update_similarity.title: Novelty Update Similarity
novelty_update_similarity.description: Cosine similarity at or above which a story updates an earlier one (below the repeat level).

thread_window_days.title: Thread Window Days
thread_window_days.description: A story joins a thread whose last update is within this many days.

brief_max_lines.title: Brief Max Lines
brief_max_lines.description: Most lines in one brief (the highest ranked).

brief_alert.title: Brief Alert
brief_alert.description: Send the morning brief's top lines through the alert routing (Telegram or email, by your alert rules) when it is written.

gdelt_themes.title: Gdelt Themes
gdelt_themes.description: Fetch GDELT's average tone and share of coverage for each watch theme once a day (free, no key, one request per five seconds). Shown next to the theme counts; never used for ranking or alerts.

gdelt_max_themes.title: Gdelt Max Themes
gdelt_max_themes.description: Most themes fetched from GDELT per run.

theme_narratives.title: Theme Narratives
theme_narratives.description: On Mondays the brief job writes a short cited narrative for each watch theme with enough items in the week (needs the brief model's key).

triage_model.title: Triage Model
triage_model.description: Triages each wire item: relevance to a global equity portfolio, topic, named entities and a one-line gloss. Decides what gets full text and analysis.

triage_effort.title: Triage Effort
triage_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

triage_per_run.title: Triage Per Run
triage_per_run.description: Wire items triaged per run (0: none).

triage_fulltext_relevance.title: Triage Fulltext Relevance
triage_fulltext_relevance.description: An unlinked wire item triaged at this relevance or above is also fetched for full text (linked items always are).

batch_extraction.title: Batch Extraction
batch_extraction.description: Send extraction through the provider's batch endpoint (half price, but a run waits up to an hour for the results).

batch_analysis.title: Batch Analysis
batch_analysis.description: Send the model stages of the analysis (impact notes, framing, sentiment, thesis link) of stories below severity 3 through the provider's batch endpoint (half price, a run waits up to an hour). Severe stories are analysed directly, at once.

reuse_repeat_analysis.title: Reuse Repeat Analysis
reuse_repeat_analysis.description: A story the novelty step marks as a repeat of an earlier one with the same holding takes that story's framing, sentiment and impact notes instead of asking the model again. Severe stories are always analysed afresh.

sector_benchmarks.title: Sector Benchmarks
sector_benchmarks.description: Price symbol of the sector index to measure a holding against, by the holding's sector (for example {'Technology': 'xlk.us'}). Without an entry the country's market index is used.

auto_resolve_days.title: Auto Resolve Days
auto_resolve_days.description: A story that is confirmed or corroborated and has had no new item for this many days is marked resolved (0: only you resolve stories).

sentiment_weight.title: Sentiment Weight
sentiment_weight.description: How much a strong verified sentiment can raise a story's rank in the briefs (0: sentiment is not used for ranking).

indirect_alert_min_severity.title: Indirect Alert Min Severity
indirect_alert_min_severity.description: A story that reaches its holding only through a competitor, supplier, customer or watch topic alerts only from this severity up (direct links alert from 1).

embedding_model.title: Embedding Model
embedding_model.description: Multilingual embedding of each wire item, used to group the same event reported in different languages. Needs GOOGLE_API_KEY.

embedding_duplicate_threshold.title: Embedding Duplicate Threshold
embedding_duplicate_threshold.description: Cosine similarity at or above which two wire items within the window are the same event. High on purpose: a missed duplicate costs a repeat in the wire, a wrong one hides a story. Tune with `python -m steward.news.eval_cluster --live`.

duplicate_window_hours.title: Duplicate Window Hours
duplicate_window_hours.description: Items further apart than this are not grouped.

fulltext_per_run.title: Fulltext Per Run
fulltext_per_run.description: Article pages fetched per run for holding-linked wire items (0: none). Each source's own hourly allowance (`fetch.max_requests_per_hour`) also applies.

fulltext_browser_fallback.title: Fulltext Browser Fallback
fulltext_browser_fallback.description: Read an article page in a headless browser when a plain request is refused (HTTP 403/429) or the page is an empty JavaScript shell. Never logs in or bypasses a paywall. Needs Playwright (the `browser` extra).

NewsSettings.title: NewsSettings
NewsSettings.description: The news pipeline after ingest: classification, corroboration.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 1: the company, regulators, central banks, official newswires. 2: curated outlets. 3: blogs and social (labelled sentiment, never alert alone).

type.title: Type
type.description: rss: an RSS or Atom feed. page: a news page read daily; new links on it become items. edgar: every holding's SEC filings. finnhub: US company news. google_news: a Google News query per holding (unofficial endpoint). rns: UK regulatory announcements per holding (Investegate company page). eqs: German regulatory announcements (EQS News company page from the holding profile's regulatory_news_urls). edgar_fts: SEC full-text search for each holding's watch topics and for other filers naming it.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Holdings this source is about (e.g. a company's own IR feed): its items link to them without a name match. Empty: items are matched by name.

macro.title: Macro
macro.description: A macro or central-bank source: its items are kept without matching a holding and appear under Markets and macro.

region.title: Region
region.description: ISO country of the outlet or authority (US, GB, JP, ...). Null: global.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the source's items when the feed does not say (ISO 639).

paywall.title: Paywall
paywall.description: open: the article page is readable. metered: some free reads. hard: only headline and summary are public. Never bypassed.

state_media.title: State Media
state_media.description: State-run media: labelled, and never the only corroboration of a political story.

bias_note.title: Bias Note
bias_note.description: Short label shown with the outlet (tabloid, trade press, state media).

needs_alt.title: Needs Alt
needs_alt.description: The feed is blocked or gone (HTTP 402/403/404); kept off until another route (Google News query, browser rung) is configured.

portfolio_topics.title: Portfolio Topics
portfolio_topics.description: Watch topics for the whole portfolio (macro, regulation, rates, currencies, sectors, supply chain). Matching wire items are tagged with the topic id.

syndication_groups.title: Syndication Groups
syndication_groups.description: Outlets that republish one wire's copy. A story carried by several of them counts as one independent source, not several.

domain_tiers.title: Domain Tiers
domain_tiers.description: Trust tier per outlet domain (subdomains included). Every holding's IR and results domains count as tier 1.

blocked_domains.title: Blocked Domains
blocked_domains.description: Items from these outlets are dropped.

allowed_domains.title: Allowed Domains
allowed_domains.description: When set, aggregator items (Finnhub, Google News) are kept only from these outlets (and the tiered ones above).

unknown_outlet_tier.title: Unknown Outlet Tier
unknown_outlet_tier.description: Tier for an aggregator's item from an outlet not listed above.

include_tier3.title: Include Tier3
include_tier3.description: Keep tier-3 items (labelled sentiment; they never alert on their own).

google_news_locale.description: The Google News edition searched by google_news sources.

total.title: Total
total.description: Stories first published in the window (repeats excluded).

unclassified.title: Unclassified
unclassified.description: Of those, stories not yet classified.

per_day.title: Per Day
per_day.description: Every UTC day of the window, oldest first.

by_event_type.title: By Event Type
by_event_type.description: Classified stories per event type, most first.

disputed_count.title: Disputed Count
disputed_count.description: Stories in the window whose sources contradict each other (status disputed, including ones the owner has since marked false).

rows_stored.title: Rows Stored
rows_stored.description: New rows only: running it twice stores nothing new.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Why a block or the whole filing stored nothing.

check.title: Check
check.description: The claim verifier's result; null when not checked.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Where a matching event is sent immediately.

during_quiet_hours.title: During Quiet Hours
during_quiet_hours.description: hold_until_end: send when quiet hours end. send: send anyway. digest_only: do not send; it appears in the next digest.

daily_alert_cap.title: Daily Alert Cap
daily_alert_cap.description: Most alerts sent per day (in the quiet-hours timezone); the rest wait for the digest. Null: no cap.

repeat_throttle_hours.title: Repeat Throttle Hours
repeat_throttle_hours.description: Another story with the same holding and event type within this many hours of an alert is not alerted again.

quiet_all_day_on.title: Quiet All Day On
quiet_all_day_on.description: Days treated as quiet from start to end: alerts are held (or go to the digest) as during quiet hours. Holidays are the public holidays of holiday_country.

system_alert_severity.title: System Alert Severity
system_alert_severity.description: Severity of monitoring alerts (a failed job, a missed run, a holding with no news coverage); routed by the rules like any event. 0: never alert.

digest_channels.title: Digest Channels
digest_channels.description: Where the daily and weekly digests go.

funds_loaded.title: Funds Loaded
funds_loaded.description: Tracked funds with a reconciled N-PORT filing.

scope.title: Scope
scope.default: Only the portfolio's US-registered funds that lack an issuer holdings snapshot; absence of a fund is not evidence it does not hold the security.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: How it was computed and from what.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: geographic, product or segment, as the company reports it

cost_per_useful_event.title: Cost Per Useful Event
cost_per_useful_event.description: Null while no story has been marked useful or alerted and left unmarked.

repair.title: Repair
repair.description: Re-run the refresh job behind a data-quality issue and retry a failed collector. Off: issues are only listed.

retry_hours.title: Retry Hours
retry_hours.description: Wait this long between two repair attempts.

max_attempts.title: Max Attempts
max_attempts.description: An issue that survives this many repair attempts goes to Needs you.

block_reset_days.title: Block Reset Days
block_reset_days.description: Lift a provider block this old so the next call probes it again (0: never). A block that returns after the probe goes to Needs you.

refresh_derived.title: Refresh Derived
refresh_derived.description: Rebuild the benchmark index weights and the fund coverage ledger from the stored fund holdings, so they follow every look-through refresh without a button.

suggest_rebalance.title: Suggest Rebalance
suggest_rebalance.description: Once a day, when positions have drifted outside their bands, put the rebalance trades (what, how much, why) in Needs you. Nothing is sent to the broker.

suggest_hour_utc.title: Suggest Hour Utc
suggest_hour_utc.description: The hour (UTC) the daily suggestion is worked out.

key_notices.title: Key Notices
key_notices.description: Name each API key that is missing for a job that is switched on.

budget_forecast.title: Budget Forecast
budget_forecast.description: Warn once a month when the AI spend is on course to pass the monthly cap.

autolog_trades.title: Autolog Trades
autolog_trades.description: Put each detected trade on the journal timeline (a journal entry, or a switch-log row for a sell and buy pair) marked as automatic. They hold no reasons and are left out of the scorecard and process review.

anticipate_earnings.title: Anticipate Earnings
anticipate_earnings.description: Once a day, put a line in Needs you for each held company that reports within three days, with when its research was last refreshed.

draft_case_items.title: Draft Case Items
draft_case_items.description: Once a day, add your thesis wording to a held company's case items as drafts (why owned, pre-mortem, exit conditions). Never confirmed, never added twice.

tune_alerts.title: Tune Alerts
tune_alerts.description: Once a day, lower one instant alert type to a digest highlight when you acknowledged under 10% of at least 10 of them in 60 days. A new event-rules version you can roll back; never below a digest highlight.

suggest_opportunities.title: Suggest Opportunities
suggest_opportunities.description: Once a day, run your saved stock screens and tell you about a stock that newly passes one and is not held. The criteria are yours; nothing is ranked or scored.

release_gate.title: Release Gate
release_gate.description: Switch off a feature you turned on once it has failed the release gate for `retry_hours` (a stale input or a failed audit), and say so in Needs you.

fill_segment_map.title: Fill Segment Map
fill_segment_map.description: Once a day, map a held company's revenue members that the filing names as a country to that country. Regions and anything you removed or changed are left alone.

journal_gaps.title: Journal Gaps
journal_gaps.description: Tell the owner about a recent trade the journal does not explain, or a sell and a buy that look like a switch. Never writes a journal or switch-log entry.

OpsSettings.title: OpsSettings
OpsSettings.description:
The ops watchdog: fixes what it safely can (retry a failed job, re-run a refresh, lift
an old provider block), and puts one line in "Needs you" for what it could not.

months_to_cap.title: Months To Cap
months_to_cap.description: Months of deposits (all going elsewhere, no price moves) until the weight is at or under the cap; null when not reached in three years.

trim_weight.title: Trim Weight
trim_weight.description: Where a trim takes it: 8 %, or 10 % above the backstop.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: 'derived' entries are computed from fund holdings the app stores and are recomputed when those holdings are refreshed.

snoozed.title: Snoozed
snoozed.description: Data-quality issues you set aside, with their dates.

trend.description: Null when fewer than two quarters are known.

pct_of_shares_outstanding.title: Pct Of Shares Outstanding
pct_of_shares_outstanding.description: All 13F holders' shares (x ads_ratio) / shares outstanding, as a fraction.

index_url.title: Index Url
index_url.description: The SEC page listing the data sets (zip files).

affected_weight.title: Affected Weight

questions.title: Questions

approve.title: Approve

mapped.description: Mapped value over total portfolio value.

denominator.title: Denominator

none_known.title: None Known

uncovered.description: Holdings with none: unknown, not zero.

points.title: Points
points.description: Daily flow-adjusted portfolio value index, 100 on the first day. Not a price: deposits and withdrawals are excluded, so day-over-day change is investment return only. Only meaningful rebased (against itself or the benchmark), never read as an absolute figure.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Why there is no portfolio history, when there is none.

values_currency.title: Values Currency
values_currency.description: Currency of `values`: the latest snapshot's base currency; null before the first sync.

values.title: Values
values.description: Absolute figures of every day snapshot in the window, oldest first, in `values_currency` (snapshots taken in another base currency are left out). Unlike `points` these include deposits and withdrawals.

day.title: Day
day.description: UTC day of the path (the latest with bars).

points.title: Points
points.description: Every 5-minute timestamp any covered holding traded at, oldest first. A holding counts at its previous close before its first bar of the day.

previous_value.title: Previous Value
previous_value.description: Covered holdings at their previous closes (base currency).

covered_weight.title: Covered Weight
covered_weight.description: Share of the snapshot's value (base currency) the covered positions hold.

value.title: Value
value.description: Covered holdings' value in the base currency.

freshness.description: Null until the first successful sync.

last_sync.description: The latest sync job, whatever its status.

base_currency_mismatch.title: Base Currency Mismatch
base_currency_mismatch.description: The active strategy's base currency differs from the snapshot's; the next sync converts to the new one.

benchmark.description: The same figures for the benchmark, converted to the base currency; null without a configured benchmark.

current_drawdown.title: Current Drawdown
current_drawdown.description: Fall of the latest portfolio level below its peak in the window, fraction.

beta.title: Beta
beta.description: Portfolio beta against the benchmark (covariance of daily returns over the benchmark's variance); null without a benchmark or enough shared days.

PortfolioTopic.title: PortfolioTopic
PortfolioTopic.description:
A portfolio-level watch topic: wire items that mention one of its keywords are tagged
with it, so a relevant story that names no holding is still found by topic. A tag never
links an item to a holding and never alerts.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The snapshot the weights come from.

benchmark.description: The Prices config's first benchmark, via the fund configured for it.

comparisons.title: Comparisons
comparisons.description: Every configured fund's (and, where published, its index's) figures.

status.title: Status

risk_share.title: Risk Share
risk_share.description: Euler share of the forecast variance; all positions sum to 1.

marginal_risk.title: Marginal Risk
marginal_risk.description: Change in annualised portfolio volatility per unit of weight.

weight_of_invested.title: Weight Of Invested
weight_of_invested.description: Share of the invested part (positions without cash).

last_price.title: Last Price

risk_share.title: Risk Share
risk_share.description: Share of the portfolio's forecast variance (Euler).

risk_to_weight.title: Risk To Weight
risk_to_weight.description: Risk share divided by weight; above 1 it adds more than its size.

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Holdings that move with it (weekly correlation 0.6+).

cluster_weight.title: Cluster Weight
cluster_weight.description: The position plus its cluster, share of the portfolio.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

hard_limit.title: Hard Limit
hard_limit.description: Weight above which the position raises an alert, not just a digest flag.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: A disabled rule is kept in the config (and still validated) but never evaluated: no breach, no review compliance row, not offered to the AI.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Holdings the rule skips (the core ETFs); they still count toward the look-through limit. Only for a rule that applies to every position.

PositionWeightRule.title: PositionWeightRule
PositionWeightRule.description: Limit on a single position's weight; with no ticker it applies to every position.

not_additive.title: Not Additive
not_additive.default: Control stakes (13D/G), institutional 13F positions and N-PORT fund positions measure different things at different dates and overlap; no total or combined percentage is computed anywhere.

rules.description: Thresholds for this check only; when omitted the strategy's are used.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.description: Cash added (or taken out) alongside the trades.

risk.description: Ex-ante risk of the book before and after the trades (plan Q5.1).

horizon_years.title: Horizon Years
horizon_years.description: Defaults to the strategy's horizon, else 3 years.

risk_contribution_cap.title: Risk Contribution Cap
risk_contribution_cap.description: Largest share of the portfolio's volatility one stock may account for. Unset: the share is shown but not judged, because the strategy states no number.

score_for_full_start.title: Score For Full Start
score_for_full_start.description: Risk-adjusted score that earns the full tier starting cap; a lower score starts proportionally smaller. Unset: not applied.

event_loss_budget.title: Event Loss Budget
event_loss_budget.description: Most of the portfolio one results day may cost; the starting size is cut to fit the stock's largest past move on a report date. Unset: not applied.

equity_premium.title: Equity Premium
equity_premium.description: Yearly return above cash that the market is assumed to pay; the anchor the quarter-Kelly bound pulls a thesis return toward.

confidence_low.title: Confidence Low

PretradeRules.title: PretradeRules
PretradeRules.description:
The thresholds of principles 8, 9 and 10. Defaults are the strategy's stated values; each
can be changed for one check.

risk_contribution_cap.title: Risk Contribution Cap
risk_contribution_cap.description: Largest share of portfolio volatility one stock may account for (null: shown but not judged).

score_for_full_start.title: Score For Full Start
score_for_full_start.description: The risk-adjusted score ((annualised thesis return - cash rate) / volatility) that earns the full tier starting cap. A stock scoring half of it starts at half the cap; a ceiling only, never above the tier cap. Null: not applied.

event_loss_budget.title: Event Loss Budget
event_loss_budget.description: Most of the portfolio one results day may cost, as a fraction (0.01 = 1 %). The starting size is cut so that the stock's largest past move on a report date stays inside it. Null: not applied.

equity_premium.title: Equity Premium
equity_premium.description: Yearly return above cash the market is assumed to pay; the anchor a thesis return is pulled toward in the quarter-Kelly bound.

confidence_low.title: Confidence Low
confidence_low.description: Weight on the thesis return at conviction 1.

confidence_high.title: Confidence High
confidence_high.description: Weight on the thesis return at conviction 5.

PretradeThresholds.title: PretradeThresholds
PretradeThresholds.description:
The thresholds the pre-trade check uses for principles 8, 9 and 10. The defaults are the
strategy's stated values; a check run without its own rules reads these.

PriceBarOut.title: PriceBarOut
PriceBarOut.description: A stored daily bar. Stooq's open, high, low and volume are null when it gave none.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Symbol of the series shown (the Stooq symbol when nothing is stored).

source.title: Source
source.description: Whose daily closes: Stooq (the source of record), Yahoo Finance (unofficial), or EODHD / Alpha Vantage (free-tier gap fallbacks).

fallback_reason.title: Fallback Reason
fallback_reason.description: Why Stooq's closes are not the ones shown.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Date of the latest stored close.

correlations.title: Correlations
correlations.description: With each other holding, last 252 days.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Why there is no price history, when there is none.

plausibility.description: Latest stored close vs Trading212's price on a sync day.

benchmark_symbols.title: Benchmark Symbols
benchmark_symbols.description: Stooq symbols of the benchmarks (^spx S&P 500, ^dax DAX, ^ukx FTSE 100). The first is used for beta and the holding charts.

history_years.title: History Years
history_years.description: Years of daily closes fetched for holdings. The covariance model needs three years of weekly returns. Benchmarks, proxy ETFs and FX use `reference_history_years`.

reference_history_years.title: Reference History Years
reference_history_years.description: Years of daily closes fetched for benchmarks, the market strip and proxy ETFs, and of ECB FX rates. Longer than the holdings' history so that stress replays can reach the 2008 and 2011 episodes through proxies.

proxy_series.title: Proxy Series
proxy_series.description: Sector and region ETFs collected as stand-ins for holdings with under three years of history (the ex-ante risk model regresses a recent listing on the best-fitting one).

plausibility_tolerance_pct.title: Plausibility Tolerance Pct
plausibility_tolerance_pct.description: Largest gap between Stooq's close and Trading212's price on a sync day before it is flagged.

market_strip.title: Market Strip
market_strip.description: Index quotes on the market strip: Stooq symbols (collected with the benchmarks), the label shown and optionally the Yahoo symbol of the same index. Stooq's close first; else Yahoo's; for PX (^px) the Prague Stock Exchange's page, read once a day. An index no source has data for shows as empty.

yahoo_daily_fallback.title: Yahoo Daily Fallback
yahoo_daily_fallback.description: Daily closes from Yahoo Finance (unofficial) for a symbol Stooq refuses, cannot be reached for or has no symbol for. Stooq stays the source of record.

intraday_enabled.title: Intraday Enabled
intraday_enabled.description: Intraday prices (Yahoo Finance, unofficial): 5-minute bars about 15 minutes delayed, polled only while each listing's market is open, and fetched when a holding page opens. Unofficial: it may rate-limit or break without notice; pages then fall back to daily closes with a note.

intraday_interval_minutes.title: Intraday Interval Minutes
intraday_interval_minutes.description: How often intraday prices are polled while a market is open (minutes).

intraday_cache_seconds.title: Intraday Cache Seconds
intraday_cache_seconds.description: A holding page re-fetches its intraday prices when the stored ones are older than this during trading hours.

PriceSettings.title: PriceSettings
PriceSettings.description:
Daily price history (Stooq, Yahoo as the fallback), intraday prices (Yahoo) and the
risk figures computed from the daily closes.

share.title: Share
share.description: Share of the company's annual revenue.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why there is no value, or a caveat.

default_text.title: Default Text
default_text.description: The built-in prompt, used while no override is set.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: System prompt text per AI step, replacing the built-in default.

override_providers.title: Override Providers
override_providers.description: The providers an override applies to. An override with no entry here applies to every provider; with an entry, only to those, and a step on another provider sends the built-in default (the default is the one the evals cover).

PromptsConfig.title: PromptsConfig
PromptsConfig.description: Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `prompts`. No override: the default is used.

rule_ids.title: Rule Ids

kpis.title: Kpis
kpis.description: Thesis KPIs it rests on, as TICKER:kpi_id.

additions.title: Additions
additions.description: Securities from the investable universe or a watchlist to add.

deposit.title: Deposit

ProposedRequest.description: Hypothetical weights; held positions not listed keep their weight.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of total portfolio value, 0 to 1.

ProviderJobSettings.description:

available, meaning its API key is set when it needs one.

state.description: Worst access state among the endpoints the metrics use.

unlocks.title: Unlocks
unlocks.description: Metric labels that depend on this provider.

match.title: Match

ProxySeries.title: ProxySeries

A sector or region ETF whose daily closes stand in for a holding with a short history

backfilled from it.

probability.title: Probability

PublicDataSettings.description: Curated Phase-2 requests. Every series names a product consumer.

target_overrides.description: Ticker -> target weight (0 to 1) to use instead of the strategy's (what-if only).

openfigi_refresh_days.description: Re-map each ISIN through OpenFIGI this often.

max_subsidiary_aliases.description: Most GLEIF subsidiary names added to a holding's news aliases.

wikidata_languages.title: Wikidata Languages
wikidata_languages.description: Languages (ISO 639 codes) whose Wikidata labels and aliases are read.

ReferenceSettings.title: ReferenceSettings
ReferenceSettings.description: Identity and reference data: OpenFIGI, ESMA FIRDS/FITRS, GLEIF, Wikidata.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Country (code or name) -> share of the region.

concept.title: Concept
concept.description: The filed XBRL element, so the figure can be checked.

holding_profiles_version_id.title: Holding Profiles Version Id
holding_profiles_version_id.description: The new holding-profiles version, when the confirmation changed it.

custom.title: Custom

channels.title: Channels

weight.description: Share of total portfolio value.

lines_reported.title: Lines Reported
lines_reported.description: Lines the manager's summary page states.
