ReportTemplate.title: ReportTemplate
ReportTemplate.description:
How a report is presented (Phase 3): sections, order, titles, depth per section and the
default view. It cannot change a code-written figure or the strategy; it only arranges.

dropped_sentences.title: Dropped Sentences
dropped_sentences.description: Model sentences removed for citing nothing checkable.

flagged_sources.title: Flagged Sources
flagged_sources.description: Sources with instruction-like text, treated as data.

links_removed.title: Links Removed
links_removed.description: Links or images in model text that were not report sources.

trace_purged_at.title: Trace Purged At
trace_purged_at.description: When the owner deleted the run's working records.

method.title: Method
method.default: Stored observations only, latest record known by the cutoff; changes are latest minus the previous period of the same series. No figure is estimated here.

primary_required_for.title: Primary Required For
primary_required_for.description: 'facts' when tier 1 is allowed: figures and dates should come from it.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Sentences per model-written section: brief 3, standard 6, deep 12.

max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Model calls plus web searches per run.

source_tiers.title: Source Tiers
source_tiers.description: Outlet tiers web search may use and the report may cite.

include_peers.title: Include Peers
include_peers.description: Name the holding's competitors and compare with them.

top_holders.title: Top Holders
top_holders.description: Largest 13F holders named in the ownership section.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The kind of run; it shapes the research plan (questions, tools, searches).

web_emphasis.title: Web Emphasis
web_emphasis.description: internal: stored records first, a quarter of the search budget; balanced and web: the full budget.

date_horizon_days.title: Date Horizon Days
date_horizon_days.description: Prefer evidence from this many days back; older sources are named as old.

allow_domains.title: Allow Domains
allow_domains.description: Domains the owner trusts, searched in addition to the tier lists. They are labelled as owner-trusted and never counted as proof.

allow_forums.title: Allow Forums
allow_forums.description: Let search use forums and social media. Their sentences are labelled.

forum_domains.title: Forum Domains
forum_domains.description: Extra hosts treated as forums or social media, added to the built-in list. Labelled as forum and searched only when forums are allowed.

stale_days.title: Stale Days
stale_days.description: Days after which a cited source of a kind counts as stale, overriding the built-in limit. Kinds: price, news_item, search, observation, default; `default` covers any other kind. Empty = built-in limits.

iterate.title: Iterate
iterate.description: After the first pass, search again for sections left thin, corroborate single-source claims, and stop when the sections have enough or the budget is used.

min_sentences.title: Min Sentences
min_sentences.description: Cited sentences a section needs to count as answered.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: A report template. It decides which sections appear, in what order, with what titles and in which view; the profile decides how the run investigates.

planner_model.title: Planner Model
planner_model.description: The model that writes the plan; unset = the claim verifier's.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: fixed: one writer call per section, searching inside it. agentic: specialist workers gather findings first (cheap model, own tools, own caps), then the profile's model writes each section from them. Both keep the claim check.

lenses.title: Lenses
lenses.description: The workers an agentic run starts, one per lens.

worker_max_steps.title: Worker Max Steps
worker_max_steps.description: Model calls (tool rounds) one worker may use.

worker_max_searches.title: Worker Max Searches
worker_max_searches.description: Web searches one worker may run; all workers together stay inside the profile's max_searches.

parallel_workers.title: Parallel Workers
parallel_workers.description: Workers running at the same time (cost control).

write_order.title: Write Order
write_order.description: template: sections are written in template order. summary_last: the executive summary, thesis KPIs and open questions are written after the evidence sections, from the sentences already written and the sources they cite instead of the whole material (far fewer input tokens). Display order is unchanged.

cheap_sections.title: Cheap Sections
cheap_sections.description: Sections written by `cheap_model` first. A cheap draft with fewer cited sentences than `min_sentences` (or a failed call) is written again by the profile's model, so a weak draft never reaches the report.

follow_up_cheap.title: Follow Up Cheap
follow_up_cheap.description: Follow-up rounds (a second source, a contradiction) are written by `cheap_model`; a follow-up that adds nothing is tried once by the profile's model.

search_mode.title: Search Mode
search_mode.description: model: the writing model runs the web searches inside each section. scouts: `scout_model` runs the same searches and returns compact extracts, which join the source registry as ordinary search sources; the writing model then writes without a search tool. Search caps and tier rules are unchanged.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: flex: the writing, scouting and planning calls ask for the provider's discounted, slower tier and fall back to standard when it is busy. batch: flex, and the claim checks (independent of each other) go to the provider's batch API, which answers within minutes to hours. For runs nobody is waiting on.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Report templates a profile can name. Kept apart from the profiles: a profile is how to investigate, a template is how to present.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: Any ticker, owned or not (a Trading212 ticker gives the richest data).

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Research profile id; default if omitted.

trace_retention_days.title: Trace Retention Days
trace_retention_days.description: Checkpoints and tool traces of succeeded research and chat jobs older than this are deleted. Reports, their sources and claim ledgers stay.

written_by.title: Written By
written_by.description: code (figures from stored records) or model

detail_only.title: Detail Only
detail_only.description: Left out of the concise view.

plan_source.title: Plan Source
plan_source.description: code, model or model fallback (with the reason).

ResultCoverage.title: ResultCoverage
ResultCoverage.description: `numerator` of `denominator` inputs were usable. The denominator is always stated.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Extra why-it-passed lines, e.g. the idea-pipeline gate.

sources_offered.title: Sources Offered
sources_offered.description: Sources in the registry when the section was asked.

sources_cited.title: Sources Cited
sources_cited.description: Distinct sources the kept sentences cite.

loss.title: Loss
loss.description: Bear case under the price, zero when the bear is above.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Snapshot date the compliance is judged on.

holding_periods.title: Holding Periods
holding_periods.description: Open lots with the date each passes the holding-period test; facts, not tax advice.

decision_scorecard.title: Decision Scorecard
decision_scorecard.description: How past journal decisions turned out (price change since the decision, each with its sample size; sections with too few decisions are not summarised).

risk_notes.title: Risk Notes
risk_notes.description: The forecast volatility from today's holdings, the factor tilts worth a look and the hardest past episode, each as a plain sentence.

bench_notes.title: Bench Notes
bench_notes.description: The bench (theses on stocks not held) against the 5 to 10 target, and the best-ranked ideas by risk-adjusted expected return.

why.title: Why
why.description: Held by the validator, or quarantined by reconciliation.

failed_checks.title: Failed Checks
failed_checks.description: The checks (bounds) the figure broke, with their detail.

restates.description: The stored fact a restatement differs from.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stocks you want researched as buy candidates, besides those the review finds.

use_batch.title: Use Batch
use_batch.description: Propose the actions through the Batch API (half price).

batch_wait_minutes.title: Batch Wait Minutes
batch_wait_minutes.description: How long to wait for the batch before proposing the actions directly.

liquidity_days.title: Liquidity Days
liquidity_days.description: A position larger than this many days of its home market's average daily turnover is flagged as hard to exit.

holder_drop_flag_pct.title: Holder Drop Flag Pct
holder_drop_flag_pct.description: A fall in a holding's 13F holder count of at least this percentage quarter on quarter is flagged.

ReviewSettings.title: ReviewSettings
ReviewSettings.description: The monthly review: compliance and figures in code, proposed actions by the model.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Facts held or quarantined now, waiting for the owner.

blocking_verdict.title: Blocking Verdict
blocking_verdict.description: Pending facts whose metric feeds a configured thesis KPI of the same holding (the KPI's metric or a component it is derived from, same basis).

reviewed_count.title: Reviewed Count
reviewed_count.description: Owner decisions (accept, correct, reject) in window.

marked_wrong.title: Marked Wrong
marked_wrong.description: Distinct facts the owner marked wrong in the window.

golden_accuracy.description: The last recorded live golden-set run of the earnings extraction; null when none is recorded.

max_drawdown.title: Max Drawdown
max_drawdown.description: Worst fall from a peak, stored history.

beta.title: Beta
beta.description: Against the first benchmark, last 252 days.

latest_rate.title: Latest Rate
latest_rate.description: Latest stored value, as a fraction.

latest_date.title: Latest Date
latest_date.description: The day the latest value is for.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: True when the preferred series (CZEONIA for CZK) has nothing stored and a policy rate stands in.

max_volatility.title: Max Volatility
max_volatility.description: Ceiling on the portfolio's annualised volatility (0.20 = 20 %). Tested two ways: realized, on the time-weighted daily returns over the last year, and as a forecast from today's weights (the higher of the EWMA and Ledoit-Wolf covariance models, cash at zero volatility). A breach of either forces a thesis review.

max_beta.title: Max Beta
max_beta.description: Ceiling on the portfolio's beta against the configured benchmark, measured on daily returns over the last year.

position_loss_review.title: Position Loss Review
position_loss_review.description: A position down this fraction or more from its cost (0.25 = -25 %) needs a thesis review. It never means 'sell'.

max_look_through_weight.title: Max Look Through Weight
max_look_through_weight.description: Ceiling on the effective weight of one underlying company reached through funds/ETFs (plus any direct holding of it): the overlap limit.

max_sector_weight.title: Max Sector Weight
max_sector_weight.description: Ceiling on one sector's share of the whole portfolio, counting funds' holdings (X-Ray). Weight with no sector is left out, not counted as a sector.

max_country_weight.title: Max Country Weight
max_country_weight.description: Ceiling on one country's share of the whole portfolio, counting funds' holdings (X-Ray). Weight with no country is left out, not counted as a country.

max_drawdown.title: Max Drawdown
max_drawdown.description: Ceiling on the portfolio's current drawdown: its fall from the highest level of the last year (0.20 = 20 % below the peak), on the deposit- and withdrawal-adjusted value.

drawdown_warnings.title: Drawdown Warnings
drawdown_warnings.description: Early-warning rungs below `max_drawdown` (0.10 = 10 % below the peak). Each raises a note naming the positions that drive the fall and the theses due for re-confirmation; the limit itself is unchanged. Only used when `max_drawdown` is set.

max_pair_correlation.title: Max Pair Correlation
max_pair_correlation.description: Ceiling on the correlation of two held positions' weekly base-currency returns over the last two years (0.85). Only pairs weighing at least `correlation_min_combined_weight` together are checked, so small positions do not raise noise.

correlation_min_combined_weight.title: Correlation Min Combined Weight
correlation_min_combined_weight.description: Combined weight, of the invested value, a correlated pair must reach before `max_pair_correlation` applies.

max_var_95.title: Max Var 95
max_var_95.description: Ceiling on the portfolio's one-day historical 95 % value at risk, as a share of the portfolio (0.03 = 3 %), from the last year of daily returns. A descriptive estimate of the sample, not a forecast.

max_es_95_month.title: Max Es 95 Month
max_es_95_month.description: Ceiling on the portfolio's one-month 95 % Expected Shortfall (the average loss in the worst 5 % of months), as a share of the portfolio (0.10 = 10 %), from the larger of the historical and filtered-historical estimates on weekly returns.

max_drawdown_probability.title: Max Drawdown Probability
max_drawdown_probability.description: Ceiling on the simulated chance that the portfolio falls by `max_drawdown` from a peak at some point within `drawdown_probability_years` (0.15 = 15 %). Needs `max_drawdown`.

drawdown_probability_years.title: Drawdown Probability Years
drawdown_probability_years.description: Horizon of the drawdown probability, in years.

max_tracking_error.title: Max Tracking Error
max_tracking_error.description: Ceiling on the annualised tracking error against the configured benchmark (0.08 = 8 %), from the last year of daily returns.

max_stress_loss.title: Max Stress Loss
max_stress_loss.description: Ceiling on the portfolio's loss when equities fall by `stress_equity_fall` (scenario engine: measured betas where valid, 1.0 otherwise).

stress_equity_fall.title: Stress Equity Fall
stress_equity_fall.description: Size of the equity fall the stress loss is measured against.

credit_spread_alert_bp.title: Credit Spread Alert Bp
credit_spread_alert_bp.description: Alert when the stored US high-yield credit spread (series us_hy_spread) is at or above this level, in basis points. A market signal, not a portfolio measure.

max_valuation_terminal_growth.title: Max Valuation Terminal Growth
max_valuation_terminal_growth.description: Flag a saved valuation scenario of a held stock whose terminal growth exceeds this rate (0.03 = 3 %): an unusual assumption to re-check.

max_valuation_growth.title: Max Valuation Growth
max_valuation_growth.description: Flag a saved valuation scenario of a held stock whose explicit-year free cash flow growth exceeds this rate in any year.

tier_risk_budgets.title: Tier Risk Budgets
tier_risk_budgets.description: Ceiling on each risk tier's share of the portfolio's forecast volatility (Euler risk contributions of the ex-ante model), by tier bucket in the 'risk' dimension, e.g. {'core': 0.45, 'growth': 0.45, 'speculative': 0.25}. A tier not listed is unchecked.

min_effective_bets.title: Min Effective Bets
min_effective_bets.description: Floor on the effective number of independent bets (Meucci's entropy of the principal-component risk shares): a book of many names can still be one bet.

tier_speculative_volatility.title: Tier Speculative Volatility
tier_speculative_volatility.description: A holding in the core or growth tier whose annualised volatility (one year of daily local-currency returns, as on its page) is above this (0.35 = 35 %) no longer meets the tier and needs a review. The owner reclassifies by hand.

tier_core_max_volatility.title: Tier Core Max Volatility
tier_core_max_volatility.description: A core-tier holding whose annualised volatility is above this (0.25 = 25 %) no longer meets the core criterion and needs a review.

auto_tiers.title: Auto Tiers
auto_tiers.description: Work out each holding's risk tier from its own numbers instead of listing holdings in the strategy: speculative if volatility is above `tier_speculative_volatility`, market cap is below `tier_speculative_market_cap` or it is not profitable; core only if market cap is above `tier_core_min_market_cap`, volatility is at or below `tier_core_max_volatility` and it is profitable; growth otherwise. A fund has no market cap or profit and is tiered by volatility alone. A classification entered by the owner still wins.

tier_speculative_market_cap.title: Tier Speculative Market Cap
tier_speculative_market_cap.description: Market cap in USD below which a stock is speculative.

tier_core_min_market_cap.title: Tier Core Min Market Cap
tier_core_min_market_cap.description: Market cap in USD a core stock must exceed.

max_stock_risk_share.title: Max Stock Risk Share
max_stock_risk_share.description: Ceiling on one stock's share of the portfolio's forecast volatility (0.08 = 8 %), from the ex-ante model. Funds the single-position rule exempts are not judged. A review prompt, not an instruction to trade (null: off).

thesis_volatility_multiple.title: Thesis Volatility Multiple
thesis_volatility_multiple.description: A held stock whose three-month realized volatility is above this multiple of the volatility band in its thesis opens a 'thesis risk profile changed' finding (null: off). It asks for a review; it never means 'sell'.

on_breach.title: On Breach
on_breach.description: Severity of a risk-limit breach (alerted when it opens).

stress_episodes.title: Stress Episodes
stress_episodes.description: Past episodes replayed on today's holdings in addition to the built-in ones (2008, 2011, the end of the CZK floor, 2020, 2022). Use the market peak and trough dates. An entry with the key of a built-in one replaces it.

RiskLimits.title: RiskLimits
RiskLimits.description:
Portfolio risk limits, checked after each sync. Every limit is optional (null = off).

A breach here is a prompt for review, not an instruction to trade: the strategy decides
buys and sells on fundamentals and news, so a price-based limit only forces a thesis review.

status_after.title: Status After
status_after.description: real, proxied or excluded after the trade.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: A: daily closes in the stock's own currency.

max_drawdown.title: Max Drawdown
max_drawdown.description: Worst fall from a peak over the stored history (negative).

correlation.title: Correlation
correlation.description: With the portfolio's daily returns over the last year.

marginal_risk.title: Marginal Risk
marginal_risk.description: Stage A: correlation x volatility. Stage B: change in the portfolio's volatility per unit of weight, from the covariance model.

observations.title: Observations
observations.description: Aligned daily returns the statistics are built on.

unpriced_runs.title: Unpriced Runs
unpriced_runs.description: Runs with steps that carry no cost.

queue_seconds_median.title: Queue Seconds Median
queue_seconds_median.description: Median wait between a job being created and starting.

entry_ids.title: Entry Ids
entry_ids.description: Journal entries the figure was computed from.

share.title: Share
share.description: Share of the n with the stated result.

usable_for_valuation.title: Usable For Valuation
usable_for_valuation.description: Null when no gate could be computed for this period: never read as a pass.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Active config version id per domain when the run started.

thesis.title: Thesis
thesis.description: The ticker's thesis as it stood.

gross_proceeds.title: Gross Proceeds
gross_proceeds.description: Account currency, at the price given.

earliest_pass.title: Earliest Pass
earliest_pass.description: When the first lot that has not passed yet will pass; null if none is waiting.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: {request, result}: the inputs and the result exactly as they stood when saved.

uses_owner_assigned.title: Uses Owner Assigned
uses_owner_assigned.description: A hop on this path is an owner-assigned weight.

method.title: Method
method.default: Price change from the price written in the journal to the latest stored close, in the instrument's currency, without dividends. A section needs at least 5 decisions; fewer are listed but not summarised.

filtered_by.title: Filtered By
filtered_by.description: What the decisions were limited to, if anything.

op.title: Op
op.description: gte: value >= threshold. lte: value <= threshold.

value.title: Value
value.description: Threshold in the metric's own unit: fractions for margins, growth, ROIC and cash conversion (0.15 = 15%), a ratio for net debt to equity.

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: exclude: drop an issuer whose filtered metric is missing. keep_unknown: keep it and list the unknown metrics.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Use only statement facts known by this time.

reconciled_only.title: Reconciled Only
reconciled_only.description: Only facts a reconciliation check passed.

valuation_gate_only.title: Valuation Gate Only
valuation_gate_only.description: Keep only rows whose period passed the valuation gate. A row with no gate is dropped, never read as a pass; the count is in the caveats.

evaluated.title: Evaluated
evaluated.description: Issuers with a computable latest period.

no_data.title: No Data
no_data.description: Left out because a filtered metric had no value.

filtered_out.title: Filtered Out
filtered_out.description: Had every filtered value and failed a filter.

valuation_gate.description: Whether this period's statements passed the valuation checks.

unknown.title: Unknown
unknown.description: Filtered metrics with no value for this issuer (only with keep_unknown).

not_covered.title: Not Covered
default: Top products: only companies whose annual report tags revenue by product are listed.
Patent areas: empty until patent data is collected (EPO OPS credentials are not set).
Trade dependencies: shown as the countries companies report revenue in, not customs data.
Credit: no sector credit spread is stored. The balance-sheet leverage of the group's own companies stands in for it, and the market-wide high-yield spread is shown beside it.

method.title: Method
method.default: Companies are the ones with a stored profile. Revenue growth and operating margin are the latest filed year from the peer-comparison engine; price/earnings is the provider's trailing figure. A median needs at least three companies with a value.

label.title: Label
label.description: "FY2025" for a fiscal year, else "3M to 30 Jun 2026".

label.title: Label
label.description: As the filing labels the member.

member.title: Member
member.description: XBRL member (e.g. country:US); null when manual.

share.title: Share
share.description: Fraction of the breakdown's sum (subtotals excluded); null for a subtotal.

subtotal.title: Subtotal
subtotal.description: The sum of other members shown (e.g. a region group).

note.title: Note
note.description: Manual rows: where they come from.

weighted_change.title: Weighted Change
weighted_change.description: Exposure-weighted average change over covered geographies only; null when no geography with exposure has two observations.

check.title: Check
check.description: The claim verifier's result: supported, unsupported (kept only in 'mark' mode) or unchecked (the verifier could not run). Null: not checked.

SeriesEffect.title: SeriesEffect
SeriesEffect.description:
Exposure-weighted latest change of one country series: sum of weight x (latest minus
previous period) over the mapped geographies that have both. `covered_weight` is the share
of the issuer those geographies represent; the rest is unknown, not unchanged.

by_severity.title: By Severity
by_severity.description: Stories first published that UTC day, per severity; keys '0'-'3', always all four.

unclassified.title: Unclassified
unclassified.description: Stories that day with no severity yet.

ratio.title: Ratio
ratio.description: numerator / denominator; null for a zero base.

Share.title: Share
Share.description: A ratio shown with the numerator and the denominator it was divided by.

ads_ratio.title: Ads Ratio
ads_ratio.description: Home-market shares represented by one share of the US-listed line (ADS ratio). Empty: the default (TSM 5, others 1).

share_classes.title: Share Classes
share_classes.description: Share-class members counted in the denominator when the filing tags shares outstanding per class, e.g. us-gaap:CommonClassAMember. Empty (the default): all classes.

manual_shares_outstanding.title: Manual Shares Outstanding
manual_shares_outstanding.description: Shares outstanding entered by hand, for issuers that do not file XBRL with the SEC (e.g. Prague-listed companies). Used only when no SEC figure exists.

manual_as_of.title: Manual As Of
manual_as_of.description: Date the manual figure is for.

manual_source.title: Manual Source
manual_source.description: Where the manual figure comes from, e.g. 'CEZ shareholder structure page'.

ShareBasis.title: ShareBasis
ShareBasis.description:
How a holding's 13F figures (shares of its US line) compare with shares outstanding.

Defaults when a field is empty (steward.fundamentals.shares.DEFAULT_BASIS_BY_CIK): one US
share represents one home-market share, except TSM (1 ADS = 5 common shares, as its
20-F states); where a filing tags shares outstanding per class, every class is counted
(Alphabet A+B+C, Novo Nordisk A+B). Narrow it to the class the US line is, e.g. GOOGL
us-gaap:CommonClassAMember or NVO nvo:BShareCapitalMember.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Set when this class's cover figure is dated differently.

classes.title: Classes
classes.description: Per class when the filing tags classes.

ads_ratio.title: Ads Ratio
ads_ratio.description: Home-market shares per US-listed share applied.

ads_ratio_reported.title: Ads Ratio Reported
ads_ratio_reported.description: The ratio the latest 20-F states, when read.

foreign_issuer.title: Foreign Issuer
foreign_issuer.description: Files a 20-F / 40-F (its US line is an ADR/NYRS).

annualised_volatility.title: Annualised Volatility
annualised_volatility.description: Sample stdev of the daily returns x sqrt(252), fraction.

mean_excess_return.title: Mean Excess Return
mean_excess_return.description: Mean daily excess return x 252, fraction.

risk_free_average.title: Risk Free Average
risk_free_average.description: Mean daily risk-free rate x 252 over the observations, fraction.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency the returns are measured in.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why `sharpe` is null, when it is.

equity_beta.title: Equity Beta
equity_beta.description: Held ticker -> equity beta the owner assumes.

unmeasured_equity_beta.title: Unmeasured Equity Beta
unmeasured_equity_beta.description: Beta used for a holding with no valid measurement; null leaves it unshocked.

duration_years.title: Duration Years
duration_years.description: Held ticker -> effective duration the owner assumes.

spread_duration_years.title: Spread Duration Years
spread_duration_years.description: Held ticker -> spread duration the owner assumes.

ShockAssumptions.title: ShockAssumptions
ShockAssumptions.description: Sensitivities the owner sets. A measured value is used unless the owner overrides it.

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: Part of the holding's move from this factor.

by_factor.title: By Factor
by_factor.description: P&L share by factor; adds to pnl_pct.

reconciles.title: Reconciles
reconciles.description: The factor split and the position lines add to the P&L, and cash, shocked and unshocked weight add to the whole portfolio.

rate_bp.title: Rate Bp
rate_bp.description: Parallel change in rates, basis points.

credit_bp.title: Credit Bp
credit_bp.description: Change in credit spreads, basis points.

fx.title: Fx
fx.description: Currency code -> move against the base currency, fraction (USD -0.1).

sector.title: Sector
sector.description: Sector -> demand move on top of the market, fraction.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country (ISO code) -> demand move on top of the market, fraction.

ShockSet.title: ShockSet
ShockSet.description: The factor moves of one scenario. Every field is optional; an empty set shocks nothing.

usd.title: Usd
usd.description: US dollar against the base currency.

rates_pp.title: Rates Pp
rates_pp.description: Change in the US 10-year yield, points.

other_fx.title: Other Fx
other_fx.description: Any other currency code (GBP, CHF) -> move against the base currency, fraction. Applies to holdings with a measured loading on that currency.

owner_betas.title: Owner Betas
owner_betas.description: Held ticker -> market beta the owner assumes.

unmeasured_beta.title: Unmeasured Beta
unmeasured_beta.description: Market beta for a holding with no measured loadings; null leaves it flat.

ShockSpec.title: ShockSpec
ShockSpec.description: The factor moves of one scenario. Every move is optional; an empty set shocks nothing.

key.title: Key
key.description: Held ticker, or the bucket name for non-position weight.

shocked_weight.title: Shocked Weight
shocked_weight.description: Weight of the leaves that were moved.

pnl.title: Pnl
pnl.description: Change in value, as a share of total portfolio value.

return_pct.title: Return Pct
return_pct.description: pnl / weight; null with no weight.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: P&L by factor: equity, rates, credit, fx, sector, country (cross terms kept in `interaction`).

sensitivities.title: Sensitivities
sensitivities.description: Each sensitivity used, with its source.

invested.title: Invested
invested.description: Market value of the open positions.

unrealised.title: Unrealised
unrealised.description: Trading212's unrealised P/L, converted from the account currency at the snapshot's own account-to-base rate.

id.title: Id
id.description: Short id cited by sentences, e.g. S3.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: The stored record: fact id, accession, URL, ...

url.title: Url
url.description: External page, when there is one.

app_path.title: App Path
app_path.description: The app page for it, e.g. /evidence/12 or /holdings/X.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The stored text it rests on.

role.title: Role
role.description: For web sources: primary, quality_news, secondary, owner_trusted or forum.

caveat.title: Caveat
caveat.description: Why this source is weaker than it looks.

quota_window_start.title: Quota Window Start
quota_window_start.description: Start of the current usage window; null if none is recorded.

quota_used.title: Quota Used
quota_used.description: Credits spent in the current window (the denominator is `quota`). Null when the period is not tracked per window or no quota is known.

quota_remaining.title: Quota Remaining
quota_remaining.description: quota - quota_used, never below zero; null when unknown.

quota_headroom.title: Quota Headroom
quota_headroom.description: quota_remaining / quota in 0..1; null when unknown.

headroom_reason.title: Headroom Reason
headroom_reason.description: Why headroom is null (no quota, untracked period, ...).

host.title: Host
host.description: The feed's host; null for per-holding sources (EDGAR, Finnhub, ...).

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: The last fetch's error, or its note when empty.

healthy.title: Healthy
healthy.description: healthy = enabled, last fetched within the Jobs config's monitoring.news_coverage_hours, and that fetch recorded no error or note

state.title: State
state.description: down: the circuit breaker is open after repeated failures (the outlet is unreachable, which is not the same as no news); degraded: the last read failed; unknown: never read successfully.

needs_alt.title: Needs Alt
needs_alt.description: Feed blocked or gone; kept off.

stored_wire_7d.title: Stored Wire 7D
stored_wire_7d.description: Items kept on the wire only.

avg_latency_ms.title: Avg Latency Ms
avg_latency_ms.description: Average time the feed or API took to answer, last 7 days.

fulltext_by_rung_7d.title: Fulltext By Rung 7D
fulltext_by_rung_7d.description: Article texts stored in the last 7 days per fetch method: '1' the feed's own text, '2' a polite page fetch with the extractor, '3' a browser render, '4' an official API.

fulltext_truncated_7d.title: Fulltext Truncated 7D
fulltext_truncated_7d.description: Of those, texts that look cut off (paywall, teaser).

fulltext_failed_7d.title: Fulltext Failed 7D
fulltext_failed_7d.description: Articles first seen in the last 7 days whose text fetch failed.

delay_p50_min.title: Delay P50 Min
delay_p50_min.description: Median minutes from an article's publication to the app first seeing it, last 7 days.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Identifier a reader can chase: accession, symbol, snapshot id.

demoted.title: Demoted
demoted.description: Below the threshold: counts one tier lower.

rule.title: Rule
rule.default: healthy = enabled, last fetched within the Jobs config's monitoring.news_coverage_hours, and that fetch recorded no error or note

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Every configured source, in config order.

day.title: Day
day.description: First day the child shares exist.

cost_share.title: Cost Share
cost_share.description: Fraction of the parent's cost that moves to the child (0 to 1).

SpinOffEntry.title: SpinOffEntry
SpinOffEntry.description:
A spin-off you entered: holders on `day` received `ratio` child shares per parent share,
and `cost_share` of the parent's cost moved to the child. The company's own notice gives the
split of cost; Steward does not look it up.

day.title: Day
day.description: First day the new share count applies.

ratio.title: Ratio
ratio.description: New shares per old share: 2 for a 2-for-1 split, 0.1 for a 1-for-10 reverse split.

SplitEntry.title: SplitEntry
SplitEntry.description:
A split or reverse split you entered. The broker's fills are not restated for it, so
without this a split shows up as a position the fills cannot explain.

known_at.title: Known At
known_at.description: Filing date: when the stake became public.

computed_percent.title: Computed Percent
computed_percent.description: Cross-check only: stake shares over the class's shares outstanding.

reported_delta_points.title: Reported Delta Points
reported_delta_points.description: Only for the same class, both reported.

risk_ceiling.title: Risk Ceiling
risk_ceiling.description: Largest weight inside the ex-ante limits (up to the tier cap).

score.title: Score
score.description: (annualised thesis return - cash rate) / volatility, the risk-adjusted score of Q8.4 on the sizing inputs.

score_size.title: Score Size
score_size.description: The tier cap scaled by score / `pretrade.score_for_full_start`; a ceiling.

event_move.title: Event Move
event_move.description: Largest past move around a report date (a fraction).

event_cap.title: Event Cap
event_cap.description: Weight at which that move costs `pretrade.event_loss_budget` of the book.

usable_for_valuation.title: Usable For Valuation
usable_for_valuation.description: Null when no gate could be computed: never read as a pass.

unmapped_concepts.title: Unmapped Concepts
unmapped_concepts.description: Facts with a concept the taxonomy does not map.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the figures shown (the converted one when a base currency was chosen).

native_currency.title: Native Currency
native_currency.description: The currency the facts were filed in.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Data date. Past dates use interval membership and facts known by then.

known_at.title: Known At
known_at.description: Only facts known by this time are used.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Apply the saved idea-pipeline rule on top of the filters.

min_sentences.title: Min Sentences
min_sentences.description: Cited sentences a section needs to count as answered.

models.title: Models
models.description: The model behind each technique that used one.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Where the story is: reported to resolved.

version.title: Version
version.description: The config version the rule comes from.

named_by.title: Named By
named_by.description: Claims in the report that name it.

formal.title: Formal
formal.description: True when the status comes from a stored check, not from the report's text.

compliance.description: For a strategy rule: the rule engine's check against the latest snapshot (status, measured value, limit, as-of date). Separate from the claims that name it.

StrategyCheck.title: StrategyCheck
StrategyCheck.description: One configured rule or thesis KPI, the condition it states, and where the report stands.

base_currency.title: Base Currency
base_currency.description: Currency every value is converted to for the overview and allocation.

fx_source.title: Fx Source
fx_source.description: Reference FX rates. Defaults to ČNB for a CZK base currency, ECB otherwise.

weight_basis.title: Weight Basis
weight_basis.description: 'total' weighs positions against positions plus cash; 'invested' against positions only.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-text guidance the AI reads; never evaluated by code.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Allocation dimensions. 'currency' is derived from the instrument unless a classification overrides it.

classifications.title: Classifications
classifications.description: Bucket per dimension for each holding, e.g. {'ASML_EQ': {'sector': 'Semis'}}.

hard_limit_severity.title: Hard Limit Severity
hard_limit_severity.description: Severity of a position above its hard limit (alerted when it opens, routed by the notification rules).

band_breach_severity.title: Band Breach Severity
band_breach_severity.description: Severity of a position, category or cash weight outside its target band. Severity 1 is listed in the next digest only; 2 or 3 also alert when it opens.

StrategyConfig.title: StrategyConfig
StrategyConfig.description:
The owner's investment strategy.

Stored as the body of `config_version` rows with domain `strategy`.

start.title: Start
start.description: The peak, or the last day before the shock.

move.title: Move
move.description: The position's own move over the episode.

pnl.title: Pnl
pnl.description: Gain or loss in the base currency.

history_start.title: History Start
history_start.description: Earliest date any series used here has a stored close.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of the fund's identified equity weight.

value_growth_rule.title: Value Growth Rule
value_growth_rule.default: Each covered holding votes: earnings yield of 6% or more and price to book of 1.5 or less each vote value; earnings yield of 3% or less and price to book of 4 or more each vote growth. More value votes make it value-leaning, more growth votes growth-leaning, otherwise blend. A holding with negative earnings is its own band, and one the app has no statements for is not classified. These thresholds are StewardAI's own and are not Morningstar's Style Box.

linked.title: Linked
linked.description: Edges where the portfolio holds both ends, so one event can hit both.

held_in_graph.title: Held In Graph
held_in_graph.description: Portfolio weight in companies that appear in the graph.

id.title: Id
id.description: Set for an entry you made (it can be removed); None for a filing.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Where the figures came from (a web address).

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The date the figures describe.

customer_share.title: Customer Share
customer_share.description: Share of the supplier's revenue this customer is.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of the portfolio held in it, directly or through funds.

direct_weight.title: Direct Weight
direct_weight.description: The part of the weight held directly; the rest is through funds.

level.title: Level
level.description: 0 for a company that only supplies; one more per step downstream.

sold_price.title: Sold Price
sold_price.description: Defaults to the stored close on that day.

bought_price.title: Bought Price
bought_price.description: Defaults to the stored close on that day.

line.title: Line
line.description: The suggestion the switch followed, as the switches list returned it: both expected returns and risk profiles, the hurdle, the lots and the tax.

share.title: Share
share.description: Share of the holding to switch.

buy_value.title: Buy Value
buy_value.description: Replacement at equal risk, base currency.

remainder.title: Remainder
remainder.description: Proceeds not used by the equal-risk purchase.

portfolio_improves.title: Portfolio Improves
portfolio_improves.description: Risk-adjusted expected return of the book improves with the switch.

limits_held.title: Limits Held
limits_held.description: No rule, cap or risk limit breaks or deepens.

flagged.title: Flagged
flagged.description: Suggested: the gap clears the hurdle with every limit held.

wait_note.title: Wait Note
wait_note.description: Switch now or after the time test.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Flags only. Nothing is traded: the owner decides in Trading212. A tax figure is the rule of thumb applied to the stored lots, not a tax computation.

SyndicationGroup.title: SyndicationGroup
SyndicationGroup.description:
Outlets that republish one wire's copy: one independence group, counted once as a
source however many of them carry a story. The first domain is the group's key.

independent_tail.title: Independent Tail
independent_tail.description: Expected number of non-overlapping periods in the tail (about n / horizon x (1 - level)); overlapping windows are not independent samples.

var.title: Var
var.description: Loss exceeded on (1 - level) of periods, share of the book.

es_95_month.title: Es 95 Month
es_95_month.description: The larger of the historical and filtered-historical figures.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

audited.title: Audited
audited.description: Subjects with at least one fact compared.

clean.title: Clean
clean.description: Subjects whose newest result is a match for every fact.

id.title: Id
id.description: A built-in section id, or the id of one of the custom sections.

detail_only.title: Detail Only
detail_only.description: Shown in the detailed view only; the concise view skips it.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Which rule matched and what happens.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channels the alert is queued for.

tone.title: Tone
tone.description: GDELT's average tone of worldwide coverage of the theme that day (negative below zero); null when GDELT is off or has no data.

attention.title: Attention
attention.description: GDELT's share of monitored coverage the theme took that day.

exposed_weight.title: Exposed Weight
exposed_weight.description: Known exposure, share of total portfolio value.

upper_bound.title: Upper Bound
upper_bound.description: Known plus unknown: the most the theme could reach.

inferred_share.title: Inferred Share
inferred_share.description: Share of the known exposure resting on inferred labels.

by_selector.title: By Selector
by_selector.description: Exposed weight per selector on its own (these overlap and do not add up).

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: 'Direct holdings' or the fund the exposure comes through.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Leaf weight, share of total portfolio value.

exposed.title: Exposed
exposed.description: Weight counted as exposed (leaf weight x exposed share).

selectors.title: Selectors
selectors.description: Every selector that matched, with its label basis.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: Weakest label basis among the matching selectors.

value.title: Value
value.description: Sector name, ISO code, issuer key…

ThesesConfig.title: ThesesConfig
ThesesConfig.description: All theses. Stored as the body of `config_version` rows, domain `theses`.

share_achieved.title: Share Achieved
share_achieved.description: Share of comparable companies that reached that growth (0-1).

comparison.title: Comparison
comparison.description: Which companies, which period and which growth were compared.
examples: US software, 5-10 bn revenue, 10-year CAGR above 12%

ThesisBaseRate.title: ThesisBaseRate
ThesisBaseRate.description: How often companies of this size and sector have achieved the growth the price assumes.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Newest verdict shown.

score_method.title: Score Method
score_method.description: How score and portfolio_score are computed.
score_method.default: score = round_half_up(100 x mean of s_k over the holding's KPIs that have a verdict); s_k = 1.0 pass, 0.5 unknown or stale (judged under an older theses config), 0.0 breach; KPIs never judged are left out, and a holding with none judged has no score. History: the score as of the end of each UTC day a verdict was recorded. Portfolio score: mean of held holdings' scores weighted by current position weight, rounded half up. State: unjudged (no score), intact (no KPI breaching), watch (one), at_risk (two or more).

portfolio_score.title: Portfolio Score
portfolio_score.description: Mean of held rows' scores weighted by current position weight, over held rows with a score and a weight. Null when there is none.

portfolio_score_history.title: Portfolio Score History
portfolio_score_history.description: portfolio_score recomputed as of the end of each UTC day any held row had a verdict recorded (latest 12 such days, oldest first), with today's weights.

verdicts_30d.description: Verdict records over the last 30 UTC days, today included.

exit_conditions.title: Exit Conditions
exit_conditions.description: Conditions that would end the thesis, in plain words.

implied_growth.title: Implied Growth
implied_growth.description: Yearly growth the current price implies (reverse DCF), as a fraction; filled from the valuation workbench when available, otherwise entered by the owner.

pre_mortem.title: Pre Mortem
pre_mortem.description: The likeliest reasons the stock loses 40%, in plain words.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.description: What would have to happen for the bear, base and bull case, with the facts each rests on. Prices and probabilities are the owner's.

dropped.title: Dropped
dropped.description: Lines removed because they named no fact in the list.

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: The facts the line rests on, quoted as given.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: Metric name the extraction job looks for.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What the threshold is in: '%', 'x', 'count', or a currency with an optional scale ('EUR bn', 'USD m', 'USD' for per-share amounts).

ThesisKPI.title: ThesisKPI
ThesisKPI.description: An absolute threshold the owner sets. v1 has no consensus-estimate comparisons.

implied_growth.title: Implied Growth
implied_growth.description: Yearly growth the current price implies (a fraction), from the reverse DCF at the valuation tab's base scenario; null when it cannot be worked out.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why there is no figure, when there is none.

catalyst_date.title: Catalyst Date
catalyst_date.description: When the thesis should have played out; the expected return is annualised to it (two years when unset, at least three months).

volatility_band.title: Volatility Band
volatility_band.description: Annual volatility the thesis expects (0.30 = 30 %). A held stock whose three-month volatility runs well above it needs a review.

sell_target.title: Sell Target
sell_target.description: Price at which the thesis has played out.

buy_target.title: Buy Target
buy_target.description: Price at or below which buying more is attractive.

bear_case.title: Bear Case
bear_case.description: Price the stock would fall to if the thesis fails, in the same currency. The pre-trade asymmetry check and the scorecard's risk section read it.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency of all the prices, as Trading212 quotes it (GBX for pence).

method.title: Method
method.description: Valuation method the targets come from.

set_on.title: Set On
set_on.description: Date of the valuation the targets come from.

ThesisPriceTarget.title: ThesisPriceTarget
ThesisPriceTarget.description:
The price levels the thesis's valuation sets, checked after each sync against the
Trading212 price. Reaching the sell target asks for the research to be re-run: sell
unless the new thesis raises the target. At or below the buy target the holding is a
candidate to add to. Scenarios alone are enough: they feed the expected return.

base_version_id.title: Base Version Id
base_version_id.description: The active `theses` version the proposal was made against.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: held: a position you own (the thesis is saved when it is written). buy: a stock you might buy (the thesis waits until you accept it).

bear.title: Bear
bear.description: Value per share if the thesis fails.

base.title: Base
base.description: Value per share if the thesis plays out.

bull.title: Bull
bull.description: Value per share if it plays out better.

ThesisScenarios.title: ThesisScenarios
ThesisScenarios.description:
Bear, base and bull value per share with the owner's probabilities (principle 5).
The expected return, the upside against the loss and the risk-adjusted ranking read them.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies.

research_profile.title: Research Profile
research_profile.description: The research profile the thesis is built on.

review_max_candidates.title: Review Max Candidates
review_max_candidates.description: Most stocks a portfolio review researches in depth (each costs a full research run). The ones you name come first.

review_discovery.title: Review Discovery
review_discovery.description: Let the portfolio review search the web for stocks that fill the gaps in your strategy, besides the ones you name.

review_discovery_model.title: Review Discovery Model
review_discovery_model.description: Searches the web for candidate stocks.

ThesisSettings.title: ThesisSettings
ThesisSettings.description:
The thesis job: started by the owner for one holding or one candidate, it researches
with every record the app holds plus web search, writes the thesis and, for a holding,
saves it. The portfolio review does the same for the stocks it finds.

disproof.title: Disproof
disproof.description: The evidence that would show the belief is wrong.

ThesisVariantPerception.title: ThesisVariantPerception
ThesisVariantPerception.description: What the owner believes that the market does not, and what would prove it wrong.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: One holding, or all when null.

flagged.title: Flagged
flagged.description: A style factor with a tilt beyond 0.3 either way.

note.title: Note
note.description: Plain sentence for a flagged tilt.

figures.title: Figures
figures.description: Figures in the result by status (ok, stale, ...).

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The newest as-of date among figures.

accession.title: Accession
accession.description: The filing the position is read from.

prev_shares.title: Prev Shares
prev_shares.description: The same manager's shares in the previous report period loaded (`top_holders_previous_period`); null when it held none then or no earlier period is loaded.

shares_change_pct.title: Shares Change Pct
shares_change_pct.description: (shares - prev_shares) / prev_shares, as a fraction (0.125 = +12.5 %); null when prev_shares is null or zero.

pct_of_shares_outstanding.title: Pct Of Shares Outstanding
pct_of_shares_outstanding.description: shares x ads_ratio / shares outstanding, as a fraction; null without a shares-outstanding figure.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Sum of `amount` over the filtered rows.

urls.title: Urls
urls.description: Discovered-URL records removed from the report.

checkpoints.title: Checkpoints
checkpoints.description: Step checkpoints deleted (the job cannot resume).

traces.title: Traces
traces.description: Tool traces removed from step details.

report_traces.title: Report Traces
report_traces.description: Per-call run traces removed from stored report bodies.

trade_value.title: Trade Value
trade_value.description: Signed: positive buys, negative sells (base currency).

estimated_units.title: Estimated Units
estimated_units.description: Units at the last price (null without a stored quantity).

funded.title: Funded
funded.description: Share of the wanted buy that the cash funds, 0 to 1.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: National trade statistics do not establish an issuer contract.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: National product trade statistics. They do not identify the issuer's customers or suppliers, and rows for different partners are listed, never summed.

value_base.title: Value Base
value_base.description: Size of the trade in the base currency.

bear_case_price.title: Bear Case Price
bear_case_price.description: Buys only: the price you expect in the bear case, in the quote currency. Overrides the thesis's bear case for the asymmetry gate.

reporter_iso.title: Reporter Iso
reporter_iso.description: ISO alpha-2 of the reporter (Comtrade stores M49 numbers).

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: raised, throttled, revision_ignored, baseline, not_material, no_baseline, persisting, review_needed, below_severity or blocked_by_gate.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Record each AI call. Off: nothing further is recorded.

exclude_job_types.title: Exclude Job Types
exclude_job_types.description: Job types whose calls are not recorded. Empty: every job type is recorded, chat included.

max_storage_mb.title: Max Storage Mb
max_storage_mb.description: Stop recording when the stored calls take this much space; nothing already recorded is deleted.

max_chars.title: Max Chars
max_chars.description: Longest prompt or answer text kept per call; the rest is cut.

TrainingCaptureSettings.title: TrainingCaptureSettings
TrainingCaptureSettings.description:
Keep a redacted copy of each AI call (prompt, answer, usage) so models can later be
fine-tuned on this app's own work. Nothing is trained or sent anywhere by this.

category.title: Category
category.description: fx: FX conversion; tax: taxes & levies.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: abs(quantity) as Trading212 reported it, in `currency`.

fees.title: Fees
fees.description: Orders: the fill's fees and taxes (walletImpact.taxes).

fees_captured.title: Fees Captured
fees_captured.description: Orders: whether the sync has read this fill's fees yet (false: stored before fee capture; the one-time order-history re-read fills it in). Null for dividends and cash.

fee_basis.title: Fee Basis
fee_basis.description: Orders with fees: whether `amount` (walletImpact.netValue) already includes them; unknown is read as excluded, Trading212's documented behaviour.

total_count.title: Total Count
total_count.description: Rows matching the filters, across all pages.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Sums per type, subtype and currency over every matching row.

dividends.title: Dividends
dividends.description: Dividend sums per currency over every matching row.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; null on the last page.

fees.description: Fees and taxes over every matching row, converted to the base currency.

prev.title: Prev
prev.description: Manager to shares at the earlier quarter.

cur.title: Cur
cur.description: Manager to shares at the later quarter.

wrong_penalty.title: Wrong Penalty
wrong_penalty.description: Score lost each time the owner marks it wrong.

useful_reward.title: Useful Reward
useful_reward.description: Score gained each time the owner marks it useful.

demote_below.title: Demote Below
demote_below.description: A source scoring below this counts one tier lower in corroboration (tier 1 as tier 2, tier 2 as tier 3).

TrustSettings.title: TrustSettings
TrustSettings.description: Source trust (layer 1): owner feedback moves a source's score between 0 and 1.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Why no filing of this report could be applied.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of total portfolio value, direct plus via funds.

unknown_fund_weight.title: Unknown Fund Weight
unknown_fund_weight.description: Share of total portfolio value in fund weight that is not accounted for by the published rows or whose fund is not looked through. Never redistributed.

dropped_uncited.title: Dropped Uncited
dropped_uncited.description: No checkable source id or allowed URL.

dropped_by_check.title: Dropped By Check
dropped_by_check.description: Removed after the claim check found them unsupported.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of invested value (cash excluded), 0..1.

pe.title: Pe
pe.description: As used: capped at 60; null when excluded or missing.

pe.title: Pe
pe.description: Share of invested value (0..1) with a P/E (incl. excluded n/m).

value.title: Value
value.description: Null when it cannot be computed (see reason).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the value is null, e.g. 'n/m: negative earnings'.

source_label.title: Source Label
source_label.description: Provider used when this individual ratio is a fallback.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: One holding, or all when null.

force.title: Force
force.description: Re-read even when nothing new was filed.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: Scenario the margin of safety is measured against.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off: the scheduled run does nothing.

full_refresh_days.title: Full Refresh Days
full_refresh_days.description: Each run re-reads a holding's fundamentals when the issuer filed a new report since the last read, and in any case after this many days.

esef_max_age_months.title: Esef Max Age Months
esef_max_age_months.description: ESEF filings (filings.xbrl.org) with an older period end are ignored.

finnhub_cross_check.title: Finnhub Cross Check
finnhub_cross_check.description: Also read Finnhub's basic financials (P/E, P/B, EPS) as a tier-2 cross-check. Needs FINNHUB_API_KEY; never required.

alpha_vantage_fallback.title: Alpha Vantage Fallback
alpha_vantage_fallback.description: Fill valuation metrics missing from SEC/ESEF with Alpha Vantage Company Overview. Needs ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY; limited to 25 requests per UTC day.

funds.title: Funds
funds.description: ETFs whose fund-level P/E and P/B are read from the provider.

ValuationSettings.title: ValuationSettings
ValuationSettings.description: Fundamentals from SEC XBRL and ESEF, with an optional Alpha Vantage ratio fallback.

count.title: Count
count.description: Verdict records created in the window (a verdict is recorded only when its outcome, figures or config changed).

per_day.title: Per Day
per_day.description: Every UTC day of the window, oldest first.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Judged under an older theses config than the active one; re-run verdicts.

sanity_max_change_qoq.title: Sanity Max Change Qoq

sanity_overrides.title: Sanity Overrides

stated_ratio_tolerance_pp.title: Stated Ratio Tolerance Pp
stated_ratio_tolerance_pp.description: How far (in percentage points) a ratio the document states may differ from the one recomputed from its raw figures before the stated one is rejected.

period_end_tolerance_days.title: Period End Tolerance Days
period_end_tolerance_days.description: Slack between a stated period end and the calendar month end expected from the fiscal year end (52/53-week fiscal years end on a weekday, not month end).

max_report_lag_days.title: Max Report Lag Days
max_report_lag_days.description: Latest a release may come out after the end of the period it reports.

large_move.title: Large Move
large_move.description: One-day move of a held stock worth a note.

WatcherSettings.title: WatcherSettings
WatcherSettings.description: How sensitive the heads-up watchers are. Bounded so none can be switched off by a typo.

found.title: Found
found.description: host + title of the first URLs found (no query string).

opened.title: Opened
opened.description: URLs a sentence cites. The provider does not say which pages the model read in full, so a cited page is the nearest evidence of one that was opened.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: New security: share of total.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Base currency, for a deposit, withdrawal or dividends.

split.title: Split
split.description: Ticker -> share of the amount (adds to at most 1); empty keeps a deposit in cash and spreads dividends over the current weights.

xirr_annualized.title: Xirr Annualized
xirr_annualized.description: False when the window is under a year: `xirr` is then the money-weighted return over the window itself, not an annual rate.

opening_gap_days.title: Opening Gap Days

gloss.title: Gloss
gloss.description: One plain sentence from triage, when triage has read the item.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.description: Triage relevance: 0 noise, 1 background, 2 may matter, 3 material.

WorkerRecord.title: WorkerRecord
WorkerRecord.description: What one worker did, stored with the report (metadata only).

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: One holding, or all when null.

quarterly.title: Quarterly
quarterly.description: Also parse the latest 10-Q when it is newer than the annual report (US issuers; 20-F filers publish annual XBRL only).

read_ads_ratio.title: Read Ads Ratio
read_ads_ratio.description: For 20-F filers, read the ADS ratio the annual report states ('each ADS represents five common shares') to check the configured share basis. Downloads the report's main document (up to about 10 MB) once per new 20-F.

XbrlSettings.title: XbrlSettings
XbrlSettings.description:
SEC XBRL fundamentals: shares outstanding and revenue by region / segment / product,
read from each holding's latest 10-K / 10-Q / 20-F XBRL instance.

portfolio_weight.title: Portfolio Weight
portfolio_weight.description: Share of the portfolio's identified equity.

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: Sum of the smaller weight per shared issuer, portfolio equity against benchmark.

portfolio_only.title: Portfolio Only
portfolio_only.description: Portfolio issuers absent from the proxy, as a share of portfolio equity.

benchmark_only.title: Benchmark Only
benchmark_only.description: Proxy constituents the portfolio does not hold, as a share of the proxy.

proxy_rows_weight.title: Proxy Rows Weight
